    fact(f"rows {r.table}", f"{r.rows:,}", f"{r.expected:,}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. view log basics
print("\n=== 3. View log basics ===")
nulls = v.isna().sum()
fact("view log null cells (all cols)", int(nulls.sum()))
fact("view log distinct users", f"{v.user_id.nunique():,}")
fact("view log distinct vsetv_id", f"{v.vsetv_id.nunique():,}")
fact("view log min start_time", v.start_time.min())
fact("view log max start_time", v.start_time.max())
fact("view log max end_time", v.end_time.max())
fact("view log exact duplicate rows", int(v.duplicated().sum()))
iso = v.start_time.dt.isocalendar().week
fact("view log ISO week range (start_time)", f"{int(iso.min())}-{int(iso.max())}")
save(pd.DataFrame({"column": nulls.index, "nulls": nulls.values}), "viewlog_nulls.csv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4. duration
print("\n=== 4. View duration ===")
d = v.duration
dd = describe(d)
print(dd.to_string(index=False))
save(dd, "viewlog_duration_describe.csv")
fact("view duration median (s)", float(d.median()), "~396")
fact("view duration max (s)", int(d.max()), "~342,145")
fact("view duration min (s)", int(d.min()))
fact("view duration == 0 rows", int((d == 0).sum()))
diff = (v.end_time - v.start_time).dt.total_seconds().astype("int64") - d.astype("int64")
viol = diff != 0
fact("rows where duration != end_time - start_time", int(viol.sum()))
vd = diff[viol].value_counts().head(20).rename_axis("diff_seconds(end-start-duration)").reset_index(name="rows")
save(vd, "viewlog_duration_mismatch_top20.csv")
fact("rows with end_time < start_time", int((v.end_time < v.start_time).sum()))
fact("views longer than 24h (duration>86400)", int((d > 86400).sum()))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5. time ranges
print("\n=== 5. Time ranges ===")
tr = [{"table": "view_log", "min_start": v.start_time.min(), "max_start": v.start_time.max(),
       "iso_week_min": int(iso.min()), "iso_week_max": int(iso.max()),
       "timestamp_raw_format": "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (naive, no tz)"}]
for p, s in sched.items():
    w = s.start_time.dt.isocalendar().week
    end = s.start_time + pd.to_timedelta(s.duration, unit="s")
    tr.append({"table": f"schedule_{p}", "min_start": s.start_time.min(), "max_start": s.start_time.max(),
               "max_airing_end": end.max(), "iso_week_min": int(w.min()), "iso_week_max": int(w.max()),
               "timestamp_raw_format": "DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS (naive, no tz)"})
tr = pd.DataFrame(tr)
print(tr.to_string(index=False))
save(tr, "time_ranges.csv")
# views falling inside each schedule's coverage
for p, s in sched.items():
    lo, hi = s.start_time.min(), (s.start_time + pd.to_timedelta(s.duration, unit="s")).max()
    inside = ((v.start_time >= lo) & (v.start_time < hi)).sum()
    fact(f"view rows with start_time inside schedule_{p} span", f"{inside:,}")
# start-time second / minute granularity (helps the later join)
fact("view start_time with seconds != 0 (share)", round(float((v.start_time.dt.second != 0).mean()), 4))
for p, s in sched.items():
    fact(f"schedule_{p} start_time with seconds != 0 (share)", round(float((s.start_time.dt.second != 0).mean()), 4))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 6. channel overlap
print("\n=== 6. vsetv_id vs channel_id overlap ===")
vch = set(v.vsetv_id.unique())
rows_per_ch = v.vsetv_id.value_counts()
ov = []
for p, s in sched.items():
    sch = set(s.channel_id.unique())
    inter = vch & sch
    ov.append({"schedule": p, "view_channels": len(vch), "schedule_channels": len(sch),
               "intersection": len(inter), "view_channels_not_in_schedule": len(vch - sch),
               "schedule_channels_not_in_views": len(sch - vch),
               "view_rows_on_matched_channels": int(rows_per_ch[list(inter)].sum()),
               "share_view_rows_matched": round(float(rows_per_ch[list(inter)].sum() / len(v)), 4)})
all_sch = set().union(*[set(s.channel_id.unique()) for s in sched.values()])
ov = pd.DataFrame(ov)
print(ov.to_string(index=False))
save(ov, "channel_overlap.csv")
missing = sorted(vch - all_sch)
save(rows_per_ch[missing].rename_axis("vsetv_id").reset_index(name="view_rows"),
     "viewlog_channels_missing_from_all_schedules.csv")
fact("view channels absent from every schedule", len(missing))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 7. schedule content
print("\n=== 7. Schedule content ===")
META = ["tv_show_genre_1", "tv_show_genre_2", "tv_show_genre_3", "year_of_production", "director", "actors"]
sc, miss, cats = [], [], []
for p, s in sched.items():
    lab = s[s.tv_show_id != 0]
    sc.append({"schedule": p, "rows": len(s), "labelled_rows": len(lab),
               "labelled_share": round(len(lab) / len(s), 4),
               "distinct_tv_show_id": lab.tv_show_id.nunique(),
               "distinct_channels": s.channel_id.nunique(),
               "distinct_channels_with_labelled": lab.channel_id.nunique(),
               "null_tv_show_id": int(s.tv_show_id.isna().sum()),
               "negative_tv_show_id": int((s.tv_show_id < 0).sum()),
               "nonpositive_duration": int((s.duration <= 0).sum()),
               "exact_duplicate_rows": int(s.duplicated().sum())})
    for c in META + ["tv_show_category", "tv_show_title"]:
        miss.append({"schedule": p, "column": c, "missing_share_labelled": round(float(lab[c].isna().mean()), 4),
                     "missing_share_unlabelled": round(float(s.loc[s.tv_show_id == 0, c].isna().mean()), 4)})
    cats.append(lab.tv_show_category.value_counts(dropna=False).rename(p))
sc = pd.DataFrame(sc)
miss = pd.DataFrame(miss)
cats = pd.concat(cats, axis=1).fillna(0).astype(int).rename_axis("tv_show_category")
print(sc.to_string(index=False)); print(miss.to_string(index=False)); print(cats.to_string())
save(sc, "schedule_summary.csv"); save(miss, "schedule_missingness_labelled.csv")
save(cats.reset_index(), "schedule_category_counts_labelled.csv")
for _, r in sc.iterrows():
    fact(f"schedule_{r.schedule} labelled share", r.labelled_share, "~0.108" if r.schedule == "11-20" else "")
# Are metadata constant within a tv_show_id?
lab_all = pd.concat([s[s.tv_show_id != 0].assign(schedule=p) for p, s in sched.items()], ignore_index=True)
cons = lab_all.groupby("tv_show_id")[["tv_show_category", "tv_show_genre_1", "tv_show_title"]].nunique()
fact("tv_show_ids with >1 category", int((cons.tv_show_category > 1).sum()))
fact("tv_show_ids with >1 genre_1", int((cons.tv_show_genre_1 > 1).sum()))
fact("tv_show_ids with >1 distinct title (share)", round(float((cons.tv_show_title > 1).mean()), 4))
ids = {p: set(s.loc[s.tv_show_id != 0, "tv_show_id"].unique()) for p, s in sched.items()}
train_ids = ids["11-20"] | ids["21-30"]
fact("labelled tv_show_ids in 31-42 schedule", len(ids["31-42"]))
fact("... of which also aired (labelled) in 11-30 schedules", len(ids["31-42"] & train_ids))
fact("tv_show_ids also in 11-20 & 21-30", len(ids["11-20"] & ids["21-30"]))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 8. series level
print("\n=== 8. Airings per tv_show_id ===")
apt = []
for p, s in sched.items():
    a = s.loc[s.tv_show_id != 0].groupby("tv_show_id").size()
    apt.append(describe(a).assign(schedule=p))
    print(p, "airings per tv_show_id:", a.describe().round(1).to_dict())
apt = pd.concat(apt)
save(apt.pivot(index="stat", columns="schedule", values="value").reset_index(), "airings_per_tv_show_id_describe.csv")
a_all = lab_all.groupby("tv_show_id").size()
dist_titles = lab_all.groupby("tv_show_id").tv_show_title.nunique()
save(pd.DataFrame({"airings": a_all, "distinct_titles": dist_titles}).sort_values("airings", ascending=False)
     .join(lab_all.drop_duplicates("tv_show_id").set_index("tv_show_id")[["tv_show_title", "tv_show_category"]])
     .head(30).reset_index(), "top30_tv_show_id_by_airings.csv")
fact("tv_show_ids (all 3 schedules) with exactly 1 airing (share)", round(float((a_all == 1).mean()), 4))
fact("median airings per tv_show_id (all 3 schedules)", float(a_all.median()))
fact("median distinct titles per tv_show_id", float(dist_titles.median()))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 9. airing duration
print("\n=== 9. Airing duration (labelled) ===")
ad = describe(lab_all.duration)
print(ad.to_string(index=False))
save(ad, "airing_duration_labelled_describe.csv")
fact("labelled airing duration median (s)", float(lab_all.duration.median()))

# schedule overlaps within channel (relevant for join later)
ovl = []
for p, s in sched.items():
    t = s[["channel_id", "start_time", "duration"]].sort_values(["channel_id", "start_time"])
    end = t.start_time + pd.to_timedelta(t.duration, unit="s")
    nxt = t.groupby("channel_id").start_time.shift(-1)
    gap = (nxt - end).dt.total_seconds()
    ovl.append({"schedule": p, "consecutive_pairs": int(gap.notna().sum()),
                "overlapping_pairs(gap<0)": int((gap < 0).sum()), "exact_contiguous(gap==0)": int((gap == 0).sum()),
                "gaps(gap>0)": int((gap > 0).sum()), "duplicate_channel_start": int(t.duplicated(["channel_id", "start_time"]).sum())})
ovl = pd.DataFrame(ovl)
print(ovl.to_string(index=False))
save(ovl, "schedule_contiguity.csv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 10. submission
print("\n=== 10. submission.csv ===")
fact("submission columns", ",".join(sub.columns), "user_id,tv_show_id")
fact("submission duplicate user_ids", int(sub.user_id.duplicated().sum()))
fact("submission tv_show_id distinct values", ",".join(sub.tv_show_id.unique()[:5]))
upc = v.groupby("user_id").size()
in_log = sub.user_id.isin(upc.index)
fact("submission users present in view log (weeks 11-30)", int(in_log.sum()))
fact("submission users with 0 view rows in weeks 11-30", int((~in_log).sum()))
fact("view-log users not in submission", int((~upc.index.isin(sub.user_id)).sum()))
sub_rows = upc.reindex(sub.user_id).fillna(0)
save(describe(sub_rows).rename(columns={"value": "view_rows_per_submission_user"}), "submission_users_viewrows_describe.csv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 11. per-user rows
print("\n=== 11. View rows per user ===")
pu = describe(upc)
print(pu.to_string(index=False))
save(pu, "viewlog_rows_per_user_describe.csv")
fact("view rows/user min", int(upc.min()))
fact("view rows/user median", float(upc.median()))
fact("view rows/user p90", float(upc.quantile(0.9)))
fact("view rows/user max", int(upc.max()))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- plots
print("\n=== Plots ===")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
bins = np.logspace(0, np.log10(max(d.max(), 2)), 80)
ax.hist(d[d > 0], bins=bins, color="#3b6ea5")
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.axvline(d.median(), color="#c0392b", ls="--", label=f"median = {d.median():.0f} s")
ax.set(title="View duration distribution (weeks 11-30, duration > 0)", xlabel="View duration (seconds, log scale)",
       ylabel="Number of view-log rows")
ax.legend(); savefig(fig, "01_view_duration_hist_logx.png")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
vc = upc.value_counts().sort_index()
ax.scatter(vc.index, vc.values, s=8, color="#3b6ea5")
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set(title="View-log rows per user (weeks 11-30)", xlabel="Number of view-log rows per user (log)",
       ylabel="Number of users (log)")
savefig(fig, "02_views_per_user_loglog.png")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
per_day = v.groupby(v.start_time.dt.floor("D")).size()
ax.plot(per_day.index, per_day.values, color="#3b6ea5")
ax.set(title="View-log rows per day (by start_time)", xlabel="Date", ylabel="Number of view-log rows")
fig.autofmt_xdate(); savefig(fig, "03_views_per_day.png")
save(per_day.rename_axis("date").reset_index(name="view_rows"), "viewlog_rows_per_day.csv")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
ax.bar(sc.schedule, 1 - sc.labelled_share, label="tv_show_id = 0 (unlabelled)", color="#bbbbbb")
ax.bar(sc.schedule, sc.labelled_share, bottom=1 - sc.labelled_share, label="tv_show_id != 0 (labelled)", color="#3b6ea5")
for i, r in sc.iterrows():
    ax.text(i, 1 - r.labelled_share / 2, f"{r.labelled_share:.1%}", ha="center", va="center", color="white", fontsize=10)
ax.set(title="Labelled vs unlabelled schedule rows per file", xlabel="Schedule file (weeks)", ylabel="Share of rows")
ax.legend(loc="lower right"); savefig(fig, "04_schedule_labelled_share.png")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 6))
top = lab_all.tv_show_category.value_counts().head(20)[::-1]
ax.barh(top.index.astype(str), top.values, color="#3b6ea5")
ax.set(title="Top-20 categories among labelled schedule rows (weeks 11-42)", xlabel="Number of labelled airings",
       ylabel="tv_show_category")
savefig(fig, "05_top20_categories_labelled.png")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ld = lab_all.duration[lab_all.duration > 0]
ax.hist(ld, bins=np.logspace(np.log10(ld.min()), np.log10(ld.max()), 80), color="#3b6ea5")
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.axvline(ld.median(), color="#c0392b", ls="--", label=f"median = {ld.median():.0f} s")
ax.set(title="Airing duration of labelled schedule rows (weeks 11-42)", xlabel="Airing duration (seconds, log scale)",
       ylabel="Number of airings"); ax.legend()
savefig(fig, "06_airing_duration_labelled_hist.png")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.hist(a_all, bins=np.logspace(0, np.log10(a_all.max()), 60), color="#3b6ea5")
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set(title="Airings per tv_show_id (labelled rows, weeks 11-42)", xlabel="Number of airings per tv_show_id (log)",
       ylabel="Number of tv_show_ids (log)")
savefig(fig, "07_airings_per_tv_show_id.png")
save(a_all.value_counts().sort_index().rename_axis("airings").reset_index(name="tv_show_ids"),
     "airings_per_tv_show_id_distribution.csv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- key facts
kf = pd.DataFrame(facts, columns=["fact", "value", "expected"])
save(kf, "key_facts_step1.csv")
print(f"\nTotal audit runtime: {time.perf_counter() - T0:.1f} s")

# Project log

## Step 1: setup and data audit (2026-10-30)

### What was run
1. `python src/env_info.py` -> `outputs/environment.txt` (Python 3.13.1, Windows 11 10.0.26200, Intel64 Family 6 Model 186, 6 physical / 8 logical cores, 7.69 GB RAM; pandas 2.3.1, numpy 2.3.2, pyarrow 21.0.0, matplotlib 3.10.5, psutil 7.0.0).
2. `python -m src.build_cache`: pyarrow CSV parse with explicit types -> parquet in `cache/`. Output `outputs/load_runtime_memory.csv`.
3. `python -m src.audit` -> all audit CSVs in `outputs/`, figures in `outputs/figures/`, full stdout in `outputs/audit_stdout.txt`, key facts in `outputs/key_facts_step1.csv`.

### Column mapping (raw -> canonical), from the actual CSV headers
| file | raw columns |
|---|---|
| dataset11-30.csv (view log) | user_id, vsetv_id, start_time, **stop_time**, **duraton** |
| export_arh_*-final.csv (schedules) | channel_id, channel_title, start_time, duration, tv_show_title, tv_show_id, tv_show_category, tv_show_genre_1, tv_show_genre_2, tv_show_genre_3, year_of_production, director, actors |
| submission.csv | user_id, tv_show_id (space-separated string "0 0 0 0 0") |

Mapping applied in `src/io_utils.py`: view log `stop_time -> end_time`, `duraton -> duration`. My notes (stop_time, duraton) match the raw file; the competition page names (end_time, duration) are the canonical names used from now on. `vsetv_id` (view log) = `channel_id` (schedule).

Dtypes: user_id is **uint64** (values up to 18,417,531,283,109,304,442 exceed int64 max); vsetv_id/channel_id int32; durations int32; tv_show_id int64; year_of_production kept as string (contains values like "1996-").

### Runtime / memory
- First CSV parse: view log 5.0 s, schedules 2.2 / 2.1 / 2.1 s (rebuilt after the bug fix below: 1.9 / 1.6 / 1.9 s).
- Cached parquet load: view log 0.25 s (178 MB in pandas), schedules 1.6-1.9 s (519 / 521 / 628 MB in pandas, deep).
- Cache size: view log 79 MB parquet (raw CSV 396 MB); schedules 14-17 MB each.
- Full audit (all files in memory): 26.1 s, peak process working set 1034 MB.

### Key numbers
- Row counts match expected exactly: view log 5,821,987; schedules 1,074,235 / 1,074,394 / 1,295,378; submission 1,260.
- View log: 4,914 distinct users, 202 distinct vsetv_id, 0 null cells, 17 exact duplicate rows (34 rows involved).
- View start_time 2020-03-09 00:00:02 to 2020-07-26 23:58:42 (ISO weeks 11-30). 139 days with data; **2020-07-03 has zero rows**; 2020-07-02 has 5,108 and 2020-07-04 has 7,814 (lowest days). Active users per ISO week range 2,406 (week 26) to 4,721 (week 12); weeks 21-26 are visibly lower (`viewlog_active_users_per_week.csv`).
- Timestamps: naive local-time strings, no timezone. View log `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` with seconds (98.33% have seconds != 0); schedules `DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS`, always on whole minutes (0% non-zero seconds). """Step 2: join merged views to schedule airings (weeks 11-30 only).

Rules (see outputs/LOG.md, Step 2):
- exact duplicate view rows are dropped;
- view interval = [start_time, start_time + duration) in integer seconds of naive
  local wall-clock time (NOT end_time: 117 rows differ by +3600 s at the 2020-03-29 DST jump);
- overlapping or touching views of one (user_id, vsetv_id) are merged into blocks
  (a new block starts when v_start > running max of previous v_end);
- airings = schedules 11-20 + 21-30, duration <= 0 dropped, duplicated
  (channel_id, start_time) dropped keeping the first; airing interval = [start, start + duration);
- overlap = max(0, min(v_end, a_end) - max(v_start, a_start)), summed per (user, airing);
  frac = watched_seconds / airing duration.
The 31-42 schedule is never loaded here.
"""
import time

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from src import io_utils as io

TEST_START = pd.Timestamp("2020-07-27")  # ISO week 31 start; nothing from here on is kept
INTERACTIONS_PATH = io.CACHE / "interactions.parquet"


def to_sec(ts) -> np.ndarray:
    return np.asarray(ts, dtype="datetime64[s]").astype(np.int64)


def load_views_dedup():
    v = io.load_views()
    n0 = len(v)
    v = v.drop_duplicates(ignore_index=True)
    v_start = to_sec(v.start_time)
    out = pd.DataFrame({"user_id": v.user_id.values, "channel_id": v.vsetv_id.values,
                        "v_start": v_start, "v_end": v_start + v.duration.values.astype(np.int64)})
    return out, {"view_rows_raw": n0, "view_exact_duplicates_dropped": n0 - len(out), "view_rows_dedup": len(out)}


def merge_views(v: pd.DataFrame):
    """Merge overlapping/touching views within (user_id, channel_id). Returns blocks with n_raw."""
    v = v.sort_values(["user_id", "channel_id", "v_start"], kind="stable", ignore_index=True)
    u, ch, s, e = (v[c].values for c in ["user_id", "channel_id", "v_start", "v_end"])
    first = np.ones(len(v), bool)
    first[1:] = (u[1:] != u[:-1]) | (ch[1:] != ch[:-1])
    runmax = v.groupby(np.cumsum(first), sort=False).v_end.cummax().values
    prev = np.empty(len(v), np.int64)
    prev[0] = np.iinfo(np.int64).min
    prev[1:] = runmax[:-1]
    new = first | (s > prev)
    starts = np.flatnonzero(new)
    m = pd.DataFrame({"user_id": u[starts], "channel_id": ch[starts], "v_start": s[starts],
                      "v_end": np.maximum.reduceat(e, starts),
                      "n_raw": np.diff(np.append(starts, len(v)))})
    stats = {"merged_rows": len(m), "watched_seconds_before_merge": int((e - s).sum()),
             "watched_seconds_after_merge": int((m.v_end - m.v_start).sum()),
             "blocks_from_2plus_raw_views": int((m.n_raw > 1).sum())}
    return m, stats


def load_airings():
    a = pd.concat([io.load_schedule("11-20"), io.load_schedule("21-30")], ignore_index=True)
    n0 = len(a)
    a = a[a.duration > 0]
    n_nonpos = n0 - len(a)
    n1 = len(a)
    a = a.drop_duplicates(["channel_id", "start_time"], keep="first")
    st = to_sec(a.start_time)
    out = pd.DataFrame({"channel_id": a.channel_id.values, "a_start": st,
                        "a_end": st + a.duration.values.astype(np.int64),
                        "duration": a.duration.values, "tv_show_id": a.tv_show_id.values})
    out = out.sort_values(["channel_id", "a_start"], kind="stable", ignore_index=True)
    out["labelled"] = out.tv_show_id != 0
    return out, {"airings_raw_11_30": n0, "airings_dropped_nonpos_duration": n_nonpos,
                 "airings_dropped_dup_channel_start": n1 - len(out), "airings_kept": len(out),
                 "airings_labelled": int(out.labelled.sum())}


def channel_overlaps(vs, ve, st, en):
    """All (view, airing) pairs with positive overlap on one channel.

    Airings sorted by start; ends may be non-monotone (slightly overlapping airings), so the
    lower bound uses the running max of airing ends: every airing before the first index with
    cummax(end) > v_start ends at or before v_start. Candidates in [lo, hi) are then filtered
    on overlap > 0.
    """
    cm = np.maximum.accumulate(en)
    lo = np.searchsorted(cm, vs, side="right")
    hi = np.searchsorted(st, ve, side="left")
    cnt = np.maximum(hi - lo, 0)
    tot = int(cnt.sum())
    vi = np.repeat(np.arange(len(vs)), cnt)
    ai = np.repeat(lo, cnt) + (np.arange(tot) - np.repeat(np.cumsum(cnt) - cnt, cnt))
    ov = np.minimum(ve[vi], en[ai]) - np.maximum(vs[vi], st[ai])
    k = ov > 0
    return vi[k], ai[k], ov[k]


def union_intervals(st, en):
    cm = np.maximum.accumulate(en)
    new = np.ones(len(st), bool)
    new[1:] = st[1:] > cm[:-1]
    s = np.flatnonzero(new)
    return st[s], np.maximum.reduceat(en, s)


def build(merge=True, check=True):
    """Return (interactions for labelled airings incl. those >= TEST_START, per-user accounting, stats)."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    v, stats = load_views_dedup()
    if merge:
        v, ms = merge_views(v)
        stats.update(ms)
    else:
        v = v.sort_values(["user_id", "channel_id", "v_start"], kind="stable", ignore_index=True)
    a, ast = load_airings()
    stats.update(ast)

    ucode, users = pd.factorize(v.user_id, sort=True)
    nu = len(users)
    vdur = (v.v_end - v.v_start).values
    acct = {k: np.zeros(nu) for k in ["total", "absent_channel", "labelled", "unlabelled", "covered_by_union",
                                      "on_airings_from_test_start"]}
    acct["total"] = np.bincount(ucode, vdur, minlength=nu)
    test_sec = to_sec(np.array([TEST_START.to_datetime64()]))[0]

    a_ch = a.channel_id.values
    ch_keys, ch_first = np.unique(a_ch, return_index=True)
    ch_last = np.append(ch_first[1:], len(a))
    a_bounds = {c: (f, l) for c, f, l in zip(ch_keys, ch_first, ch_last)}
    v_ch = v.channel_id.values
    order = np.argsort(v_ch, kind="stable")
    vch_sorted = v_ch[order]
    vk, vf = np.unique(vch_sorted, return_index=True)
    vl = np.append(vf[1:], len(order))

    parts = []
    for c, f, l in zip(vk, vf, vl):
        idx = order[f:l]
        if c not in a_bounds:
            acct["absent_channel"] += np.bincount(ucode[idx], vdur[idx], minlength=nu)
            continue
        s0, s1 = a_bounds[c]
        st, en = a.a_start.values[s0:s1], a.a_end.values[s0:s1]
        vs, ve = v.v_start.values[idx], v.v_end.values[idx]
        vi, ai, ov = channel_overlaps(vs, ve, st, en)
        uc = ucode[idx][vi]
        lab = a.labelled.values[s0:s1][ai]
        acct["labelled"] += np.bincount(uc[lab], ov[lab], minlength=nu)
        acct["unlabelled"] += np.bincount(uc[~lab], ov[~lab], minlength=nu)
        late = st[ai] >= test_sec
        acct["on_airings_from_test_start"] += np.bincount(uc[late], ov[late], minlength=nu)
        us, ue = union_intervals(st, en)
        uvi, _, uov = channel_overlaps(vs, ve, us, ue)
        acct["covered_by_union"] += np.bincount(ucode[idx][uvi], uov, minlength=nu)
        # aggregate labelled overlaps to (user, airing)
        key = uc[lab].astype(np.int64) * (s1 - s0) + ai[lab]
        uk, inv = np.unique(key, return_inverse=True)
        parts.append(pd.DataFrame({"ucode": (uk // (s1 - s0)).astype(np.int32),
                                   "aidx": (uk % (s1 - s0)) + s0,
                                   "watched_seconds": np.bincount(inv, ov[lab]).astype(np.int64)}))

    x = pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)
    ai = x.aidx.values
    inter = pd.DataFrame({
        "user_id": users[x.ucode.values].astype(np.uint64),
        "tv_show_id": a.tv_show_id.values[ai],
        "channel_id": a.channel_id.values[ai],
        "airing_start": a.a_start.values[ai].astype("datetime64[s]"),
        "airing_duration": a.duration.values[ai],
        "watched_seconds": x.watched_seconds.values,
    })
    inter["frac"] = inter.watched_seconds / inter.airing_duration
    inter["iso_week"] = inter.airing_start.dt.isocalendar().week.astype(np.int16).values
    inter = inter.sort_values(["user_id", "airing_start", "channel_id"], kind="stable", ignore_index=True)
    stats["frac_max"] = float(inter.frac.max())
    stats["frac_gt_1_pairs"] = int((inter.frac > 1 + 1e-9).sum())
    if check and merge:
        assert stats["frac_gt_1_pairs"] == 0, "frac > 1 after merging"
    acct = pd.DataFrame(acct)
    acct.insert(0, "user_id", users.astype(np.uint64))
    stats["build_seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 1)
    return inter, acct, stats


def main():
    import json

    import psutil
    inter, acct, stats = build()
    late = inter.airing_start >= TEST_START
    stats["labelled_pairs_all"] = len(inter)
    stats["labelled_pairs_dropped_airing_in_week31"] = int(late.sum())
    inter = inter[~late].reset_index(drop=True)
    stats["labelled_pairs_saved"] = len(inter)
    inter.to_parquet(INTERACTIONS_PATH, index=False)
    acct.to_parquet(io.CACHE / "watchtime_per_user.parquet", index=False)
    mi = psutil.Process().memory_info()
    stats["peak_memory_mb"] = round(getattr(mi, "peak_wset", mi.rss) / 1024**2)
    (io.ROOT / "outputs" / "join_stats.json").write_text(json.dumps(stats, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(stats, indent=2))
    print(inter.dtypes.to_string())
    print(inter.head().to_string())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Step 2: join merged views to schedule airings (weeks 11-30 only).

Rules (see outputs/LOG.md, Step 2):
- exact duplicate view rows are dropped;
- view interval = [start_time, start_time + duration) in integer seconds of naive
  local wall-clock time (NOT end_time: 117 rows differ by +3600 s at the 2020-03-29 DST jump);
- overlapping or touching views of one (user_id, vsetv_id) are merged into blocks
  (a new block starts when v_start > running max of previous v_end);
- airings = schedules 11-20 + 21-30, duration <= 0 dropped, duplicated
  (channel_id, start_time) dropped keeping the first; airing interval = [start, start + duration);
- overlap = max(0, min(v_end, a_end) - max(v_start, a_start)), summed per (user, airing);
  frac = watched_seconds / airing duration.
The 31-42 schedule is never loaded here.
"""
import time

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from src import io_utils as io

TEST_START = pd.Timestamp("2020-07-27")  # ISO week 31 start; nothing from here on is kept
INTERACTIONS_PATH = io.CACHE / "interactions.parquet"


def to_sec(ts) -> np.ndarray:
    return np.asarray(ts, dtype="datetime64[s]").astype(np.int64)


def load_views_dedup():
    v = io.load_views()
    n0 = len(v)
    v = v.drop_duplicates(ignore_index=True)
    v_start = to_sec(v.start_time)
    out = pd.DataFrame({"user_id": v.user_id.values, "channel_id": v.vsetv_id.values,
                        "v_start": v_start, "v_end": v_start + v.duration.values.astype(np.int64)})
    return out, {"view_rows_raw": n0, "view_exact_duplicates_dropped": n0 - len(out), "view_rows_dedup": len(out)}


def merge_views(v: pd.DataFrame):
    """Merge overlapping/touching views within (user_id, channel_id). Returns blocks with n_raw."""
    v = v.sort_values(["user_id", "channel_id", "v_start"], kind="stable", ignore_index=True)
    u, ch, s, e = (v[c].values for c in ["user_id", "channel_id", "v_start", "v_end"])
    first = np.ones(len(v), bool)
    first[1:] = (u[1:] != u[:-1]) | (ch[1:] != ch[:-1])
    runmax = v.groupby(np.cumsum(first), sort=False).v_end.cummax().values
    prev = np.empty(len(v), np.int64)
    prev[0] = np.iinfo(np.int64).min
    prev[1:] = runmax[:-1]
    new = first | (s > prev)
    starts = np.flatnonzero(new)
    m = pd.DataFrame({"user_id": u[starts], "channel_id": ch[starts], "v_start": s[starts],
                      "v_end": np.maximum.reduceat(e, starts),
                      "n_raw": np.diff(np.append(starts, len(v)))})
    stats = {"merged_rows": len(m), "watched_seconds_before_merge": int((e - s).sum()),
             "watched_seconds_after_merge": int((m.v_end - m.v_start).sum()),
             "blocks_from_2plus_raw_views": int((m.n_raw > 1).sum())}
    return m, stats


def load_airings():
    a = pd.concat([io.load_schedule("11-20"), io.load_schedule("21-30")], ignore_index=True)
    n0 = len(a)
    a = a[a.duration > 0]
    n_nonpos = n0 - len(a)
    n1 = len(a)
    a = a.drop_duplicates(["channel_id", "start_time"], keep="first")
    st = to_sec(a.start_time)
    out = pd.DataFrame({"channel_id": a.channel_id.values, "a_start": st,
                        "a_end": st + a.duration.values.astype(np.int64),
                        "duration": a.duration.values, "tv_show_id": a.tv_show_id.values})
    out = out.sort_values(["channel_id", "a_start"], kind="stable", ignore_index=True)
    out["labelled"] = out.tv_show_id != 0
    return out, {"airings_raw_11_30": n0, "airings_dropped_nonpos_duration": n_nonpos,
                 "airings_dropped_dup_channel_start": n1 - len(out), "airings_kept": len(out),
                 "airings_labelled": int(out.labelled.sum())}


def channel_overlaps(vs, ve, st, en):
    """All (view, airing) pairs with positive overlap on one channel.

    Airings sorted by start; ends may be non-monotone (slightly overlapping airings), so the
    lower bound uses the running max of airing ends: every airing before the first index with
    cummax(end) > v_start ends at or before v_start. Candidates in [lo, hi) are then filtered
    on overlap > 0.
    """
    cm = np.maximum.accumulate(en)
    lo = np.searchsorted(cm, vs, side="right")
    hi = np.searchsorted(st, ve, side="left")
    cnt = np.maximum(hi - lo, 0)
    tot = int(cnt.sum())
    vi = np.repeat(np.arange(len(vs)), cnt)
    ai = np.repeat(lo, cnt) + (np.arange(tot) - np.repeat(np.cumsum(cnt) - cnt, cnt))
    ov = np.minimum(ve[vi], en[ai]) - np.maximum(vs[vi], st[ai])
    k = ov > 0
    return vi[k], ai[k], ov[k]


def union_intervals(st, en):
    cm = np.maximum.accumulate(en)
    new = np.ones(len(st), bool)
    new[1:] = st[1:] > cm[:-1]
    s = np.flatnonzero(new)
    return st[s], np.maximum.reduceat(en, s)


def build(merge=True, check=True):
    """Return (interactions for labelled airings incl. those >= TEST_START, per-user accounting, stats)."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    v, stats = load_views_dedup()
    if merge:
        v, ms = merge_views(v)
        stats.update(ms)
    else:
        v = v.sort_values(["user_id", "channel_id", "v_start"], kind="stable", ignore_index=True)
    a, ast = load_airings()
    stats.update(ast)

    ucode, users = pd.factorize(v.user_id, sort=True)
    nu = len(users)
    vdur = (v.v_end - v.v_start).values
    acct = {k: np.zeros(nu) for k in ["total", "absent_channel", "labelled", "unlabelled", "covered_by_union",
                                      "on_airings_from_test_start"]}
    acct["total"] = np.bincount(ucode, vdur, minlength=nu)
    test_sec = to_sec(np.array([TEST_START.to_datetime64()]))[0]

    a_ch = a.channel_id.values
    ch_keys, ch_first = np.unique(a_ch, return_index=True)
    ch_last = np.append(ch_first[1:], len(a))
    a_bounds = {c: (f, l) for c, f, l in zip(ch_keys, ch_first, ch_last)}
    v_ch = v.channel_id.values
    order = np.argsort(v_ch, kind="stable")
    vch_sorted = v_ch[order]
    vk, vf = np.unique(vch_sorted, return_index=True)
    vl = np.append(vf[1:], len(order))

    parts = []
    for c, f, l in zip(vk, vf, vl):
        idx = order[f:l]
        if c not in a_bounds:
            acct["absent_channel"] += np.bincount(ucode[idx], vdur[idx], minlength=nu)
            continue
        s0, s1 = a_bounds[c]
        st, en = a.a_start.values[s0:s1], a.a_end.values[s0:s1]
        vs, ve = v.v_start.values[idx], v.v_end.values[idx]
        vi, ai, ov = channel_overlaps(vs, ve, st, en)
        uc = ucode[idx][vi]
        lab = a.labelled.values[s0:s1][ai]
        acct["labelled"] += np.bincount(uc[lab], ov[lab], minlength=nu)
        acct["unlabelled"] += np.bincount(uc[~lab], ov[~lab], minlength=nu)
        late = st[ai] >= test_sec
        acct["on_airings_from_test_start"] += np.bincount(uc[late], ov[late], minlength=nu)
        us, ue = union_intervals(st, en)
        uvi, _, uov = channel_overlaps(vs, ve, us, ue)
        acct["covered_by_union"] += np.bincount(ucode[idx][uvi], uov, minlength=nu)
        # aggregate labelled overlaps to (user, airing)
        key = uc[lab].astype(np.int64) * (s1 - s0) + ai[lab]
        uk, inv = np.unique(key, return_inverse=True)
        parts.append(pd.DataFrame({"ucode": (uk // (s1 - s0)).astype(np.int32),
                                   "aidx": (uk % (s1 - s0)) + s0,
                                   "watched_seconds": np.bincount(inv, ov[lab]).astype(np.int64)}))

    x = pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)
    ai = x.aidx.values
    inter = pd.DataFrame({
        "user_id": users[x.ucode.values].astype(np.uint64),
        "tv_show_id": a.tv_show_id.values[ai],
        "channel_id": a.channel_id.values[ai],
        "airing_start": a.a_start.values[ai].astype("datetime64[s]"),
        "airing_duration": a.duration.values[ai],
        "watched_seconds": x.watched_seconds.values,
    })
    inter["frac"] = inter.watched_seconds / inter.airing_duration
    inter["iso_week"] = inter.airing_start.dt.isocalendar().week.astype(np.int16).values
    inter = inter.sort_values(["user_id", "airing_start", "channel_id"], kind="stable", ignore_index=True)
    stats["frac_max"] = float(inter.frac.max())
    stats["frac_gt_1_pairs"] = int((inter.frac > 1 + 1e-9).sum())
    if check and merge:
        assert stats["frac_gt_1_pairs"] == 0, "frac > 1 after merging"
    acct = pd.DataFrame(acct)
    acct.insert(0, "user_id", users.astype(np.uint64))
    stats["build_seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 1)
    return inter, acct, stats


def main():
    import json

    import psutil
    inter, acct, stats = build()
    late = inter.airing_start >= TEST_START
    stats["labelled_pairs_all"] = len(inter)
    stats["labelled_pairs_dropped_airing_in_week31"] = int(late.sum())
    inter = inter[~late].reset_index(drop=True)
    stats["labelled_pairs_saved"] = len(inter)
    inter.to_parquet(INTERACTIONS_PATH, index=False)
    acct.to_parquet(io.CACHE / "watchtime_per_user.parquet", index=False)
    mi = psutil.Process().memory_info()
    stats["peak_memory_mb"] = round(getattr(mi, "peak_wset", mi.rss) / 1024**2)
    (io.ROOT / "outputs" / "join_stats.json").write_text(json.dumps(stats, indent=2))

    print(inter.dtypes.to_string())

(frac = watched seconds of merged views / airing duration, see src/join.py).
Per (user, tv_show_id): n_qualifying_airings = number of qualifying airings,
watched_seconds_total = sum of watched_seconds over those qualifying airings.

Ranking (full list, not truncated; callers take rank <= 5):
    n_qualifying_airings desc, then watched_seconds_total desc, then tv_show_id asc.
The competition only specifies "most frequent"; how its labels break ties is
unobservable, so the two secondary keys are our own explicit convention.
"""
from datetime import datetime

import pandas as pd

COLS = ["user_id", "rank", "tv_show_id", "n_qualifying_airings", "watched_seconds_total"]


def iso_week_start(week: int, year: int = 2020) -> datetime:
    """Monday 00:00 of an ISO week, e.g. 21 -> 2020-05-18, 31 -> 2020-07-27."""
    return datetime.fromisocalendar(year, week, 1)


def build_targets(interactions: pd.DataFrame, start, end, thr: float = 0.8) -> pd.DataFrame:
    start, end = pd.Timestamp(start), pd.Timestamp(end)
    m = (interactions.airing_start >= start) & (interactions.airing_start < end) & (interactions.frac >= thr)
    t = (interactions.loc[m]
         .groupby(["user_id", "tv_show_id"], sort=False)
         .agg(n_qualifying_airings=("frac", "size"), watched_seconds_total=("watched_seconds", "sum"))
         .reset_index()
         .sort_values(["user_id", "n_qualifying_airings", "watched_seconds_total", "tv_show_id"],
                      ascending=[True, False, False, True], kind="stable", ignore_index=True))
    t["rank"] = t.groupby("user_id").cumcount() + 1
    return t[COLS]


def n_distinct_shows(targets: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Number of distinct qualifying tv_show_ids per user (users without any are absent)."""
    return targets.groupby("user_id").size().rename("n_distinct_shows")

"""Step 2 verification (C1-C4). Usage: python -m src.verify_step2 {brute,hand,repro,merge}"""
import calendar
import csv
import hashlib
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from src import io_utils as io
from src.join import INTERACTIONS_PATH, build

OUT = io.ROOT / "outputs"
SEED = 42


def secs(dt: datetime) -> int:
    return calendar.timegm(dt.timetuple())


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ C1 brute force
def naive_pairs(view_rows, airings_by_ch):
    """Pure Python: dedup, merge per (user, channel), double loop over views x airings of the channel."""
    seen, views = set(), []
    for r in view_rows:
        if r not in seen:
            seen.add(r)
            views.append(r)
    by_key = {}
    for (u, ch, st, dur) in views:
        s = secs(st)
        by_key.setdefault((u, ch), []).append([s, s + dur])
    merged = []
    for (u, ch), ivs in by_key.items():
        ivs.sort()
        cur = list(ivs[0])
        for s, e in ivs[1:]:
            if s <= cur[1]:
                cur[1] = max(cur[1], e)
            else:
                merged.append((u, ch, cur[0], cur[1]))
                cur = [s, e]
        merged.append((u, ch, cur[0], cur[1]))
    acc = {}
    for (u, ch, s, e) in merged:
        for (a_s, a_e, show) in airings_by_ch.get(ch, []):
            ov = min(e, a_e) - max(s, a_s)
            if ov > 0:
                acc[(u, ch, a_s)] = acc.get((u, ch, a_s), 0) + ov
    return acc, merged


def naive_airings():
    a = pd.concat([io.load_schedule("11-20"), io.load_schedule("21-30")], ignore_index=True)
    out, seen = {}, set()
    for ch, st, dur, show in zip(a.channel_id.tolist(), a.start_time.tolist(), a.duration.tolist(),
                                 a.tv_show_id.tolist()):
        if dur <= 0 or (ch, st) in seen:
            continue
        seen.add((ch, st))
        s = secs(st.to_pydatetime())
        out.setdefault(ch, []).append((s, s + dur, show))
    return out


def brute():
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    v = io.load_views()
    sub = set(io.load_submission().user_id.tolist())
    users = np.sort(v.user_id.unique())
    sub_users = np.array(sorted(sub))
    long_user = int(v.loc[v.duration.idxmax(), "user_id"])
    pick = [long_user] + list(rng.choice(sub_users, 5, replace=False))
    rest = [u for u in rng.choice(users, 60, replace=False) if u not in pick]
    pick = [int(u) for u in pick] + [int(u) for u in rest[:30 - len(pick)]]
    print(f"picked {len(pick)} users; long-view user {long_user} (max duration {v.duration.max()} s); "
          f"submission users among picks: {sum(u in sub for u in pick)}")

    air = naive_airings()
    inter = pd.read_parquet(INTERACTIONS_PATH)
    inter = inter[inter.user_id.isin(pick)]
    pipe = {(int(u), int(c), secs(pd.Timestamp(t).to_pydatetime())): int(w) for u, c, t, w in
            zip(inter.user_id, inter.channel_id, inter.airing_start, inter.watched_seconds)}
    labelled_starts = {(ch, s) for ch, lst in air.items() for (s, e, show) in lst if show != 0}

    rows, n_pairs, n_mis = [], 0, 0
    vv = v[v.user_id.isin(pick)]
    for u in pick:
        uv = vv[vv.user_id == u]
        raw = list(zip([int(x) for x in uv.user_id], uv.vsetv_id.tolist(),
                       [t.to_pydatetime() for t in uv.start_time], uv.duration.tolist()))
        acc, merged = naive_pairs(raw, air)
        naive_lab = {k: w for k, w in acc.items() if (k[1], k[2]) in labelled_starts}
        pipe_u = {k: w for k, w in pipe.items() if k[0] == u}
        keys = set(naive_lab) | set(pipe_u)
        mis = sum(naive_lab.get(k) != pipe_u.get(k) for k in keys)
        max_span = max((sum(1 for (a_s, a_e, _) in air.get(ch, []) if min(e, a_e) - max(s, a_s) > 0)
                        for (_, ch, s, e) in merged), default=0)
        rows.append({"user_id": u, "submission_user": u in sub, "raw_views": len(raw), "merged_views": len(merged),
                     "max_airings_spanned_by_one_view": max_span, "pairs_naive": len(naive_lab),
                     "pairs_pipeline": len(pipe_u), "pairs_compared": len(keys), "mismatches": mis})
        n_pairs += len(keys)
        n_mis += mis
        print(rows[-1])
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    df.to_csv(OUT / "verify_bruteforce.csv", index=False)
    print(f"\nTOTAL labelled (user, airing) pairs compared: {n_pairs:,}; mismatches: {n_mis}; "
          f"runtime {time.perf_counter() - t0:.1f} s")
    assert n_mis == 0


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ C2 hand examples
VIEW_FMT, SCHED_FMT = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S"


def hand():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    with open(io.DATA / "submission.csv", newline="") as f:
        sub = [r["user_id"] for r in csv.DictReader(f)]
    cand = set(rng.choice(sub, 20, replace=False).tolist())
    raw = {u: [] for u in cand}
    with open(io.DATA / "dataset11-30.csv", newline="") as f:
        rd = csv.reader(f)
        header = next(rd)
        for r in rd:
            if r[0] in raw:
                raw[r[0]].append(r)
    inter = pd.read_parquet(INTERACTIONS_PATH)

    def parse(r):
        s = datetime.strptime(r[2], VIEW_FMT)
        return s, s + timedelta(seconds=int(r[4]))

    # choose user: one with two raw views on one channel that overlap each other and both overlap a labelled airing
    chosen = None
    for u in sorted(cand):
        rows = sorted(raw[u], key=lambda r: (int(r[1]), r[2]))
        ui = inter[inter.user_id == np.uint64(int(u))]
        for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            if r1[1] != r2[1]:
                continue
            (s1, e1), (s2, e2) = parse(r1), parse(r2)
            if s2 >= e1:  # need a genuine overlap so merging changes the result
                continue
            ch = int(r1[1])
            hit = ui[(ui.channel_id == ch) & (ui.airing_start < e1) &
                     (ui.airing_start + pd.to_timedelta(ui.airing_duration, unit="s") > s2)]
            if len(hit):
                chosen = (u, ch, hit.iloc[0])
                break
        if chosen:
            break
    assert chosen, "no merged-overlap example found among 20 sampled submission users"
    u, _, merged_row = chosen
    ui = inter[inter.user_id == np.uint64(int(u))]
    examples = [("C: two overlapping raw views merged", merged_row)]
    used = {(merged_row.channel_id, merged_row.airing_start)}
    for title, cond in [("A: frac >= 0.8", ui.frac >= 0.8), ("B: frac < 0.8", (ui.frac < 0.8) & (ui.frac > 0.2))]:
        r = ui[cond & ~ui.set_index(["channel_id", "airing_start"]).index.isin(list(used))].iloc[0]
        used.add((r.channel_id, r.airing_start))
        examples.insert(-1 if title.startswith("B") else 0, (title, r)) if False else examples.append((title, r))

    lines = [f"Hand-computed examples, submission user {u} (raw lines read with the csv module only)",
             f"view-log header: {header}"]
    for title, ex in examples:
        ch, a_start = int(ex.channel_id), pd.Timestamp(ex.airing_start).to_pydatetime()
        a_line = None
        for fn in [io.SCHEDULE_FILES["11-20"], io.SCHEDULE_FILES["21-30"]]:
            with open(io.DATA / fn, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                rd = csv.reader(f)
                sh = next(rd)
                for r in rd:
                    if r[0] == str(ch) and r[2] == a_start.strftime(SCHED_FMT):
                        a_line = r
                        break
            if a_line:
                break
        a_s = datetime.strptime(a_line[2], SCHED_FMT)
        a_e = a_s + timedelta(seconds=int(a_line[3]))
        vlines = sorted([r for r in raw[u] if int(r[1]) == ch and parse(r)[0] < a_e and parse(r)[1] > a_s],
                        key=lambda r: r[2])
        lines += ["", "=" * 100, title, f"raw airing line: {dict(zip(sh, a_line[:7]))}",
                  f"  airing interval: [{a_s}, {a_s} + {a_line[3]} s = {a_e})"]
        lines.append(f"raw view lines on channel {ch} overlapping the airing ({len(vlines)}):")
        for r in vlines:
            s, e = parse(r)
            lines.append(f"  {r}  ->  view interval [{s}, {s} + {r[4]} s = {e})")
        # merge by hand
        blocks = []
        for r in vlines:
            s, e = parse(r)
            if blocks and s <= blocks[-1][1]:
                lines.append(f"  merge: start {s} <= current block end {blocks[-1][1]} -> block end = "
                             f"max({blocks[-1][1]}, {e}) = {max(blocks[-1][1], e)}")
                blocks[-1][1] = max(blocks[-1][1], e)
            else:
                blocks.append([s, e])
        # note: neighbours outside the airing could extend a block, but cannot change its overlap with the airing
        total = 0
        for s, e in blocks:
            lo, hi = max(s, a_s), min(e, a_e)
            ov = max(0, int((hi - lo).total_seconds()))
            lines.append(f"  block [{s}, {e}): overlap = min({e}, {a_e}) - max({s}, {a_s}) = {hi} - {lo} = {ov} s")
            total += ov
        frac = total / int(a_line[3])
        lines.append(f"  watched_seconds = {total} s; frac = {total} / {a_line[3]} = {frac:.6f}")
        lines.append(f"  pipeline: watched_seconds = {int(ex.watched_seconds)}, frac = {ex.frac:.6f} -> "
                     f"{'MATCH' if total == int(ex.watched_seconds) else 'MISMATCH'}")
    txt = "\n".join(lines)
    (OUT / "verify_hand_examples.txt").write_text(txt, encoding="utf-8")
    print(txt)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ C3 reproducibility
def repro():
    rows = []
    for run in [1, 2]:
        for p in io.CACHE.glob("*.parquet"):
            p.unlink()
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "src.join"], check=True, cwd=io.ROOT, capture_output=True)
        dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
        df = pd.read_parquet(INTERACTIONS_PATH)
        h = hashlib.sha256(pd.util.hash_pandas_object(df, index=True).values.tobytes()).hexdigest()
        df.to_parquet(io.CACHE / f"interactions_run{run}.parquet", index=False)
        rows.append({"run": run, "wall_seconds_incl_csv_parse": round(dt, 1), "rows": len(df), "sha256": h})
        print(rows[-1])
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(pd.read_parquet(io.CACHE / "interactions_run1.parquet"),
                                  pd.read_parquet(io.CACHE / "interactions_run2.parquet"))
    for run in [1, 2]:
        (io.CACHE / f"interactions_run{run}.parquet").unlink()
    print("assert_frame_equal: identical")
    pd.DataFrame(rows).assign(identical=rows[0]["sha256"] == rows[1]["sha256"]).to_csv(
        OUT / "verify_reproducibility.csv", index=False)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ C4 merge sensitivity
def merge():
    res = []
    for m in [True, False]:
        inter, _, st = build(merge=m, check=m)
        inter = inter[inter.airing_start < pd.Timestamp("2020-07-27")]
        res.append({"merge_views": m, "labelled_pairs": len(inter), "pairs_frac_ge_0.8": int((inter.frac >= 0.8).sum()),
                    "pairs_frac_gt_1": int((inter.frac > 1 + 1e-9).sum()), "frac_max": float(inter.frac.max()),
                    "watched_seconds_on_labelled": int(inter.watched_seconds.sum()), "build_seconds": st["build_seconds"]})
        print(res[-1])
    df = pd.DataFrame(res)
    df.loc[2] = ["difference (no_merge - merge)"] + [df.iloc[1, i] - df.iloc[0, i] for i in range(1, df.shape[1])]
    df.to_csv(OUT / "merge_sensitivity.csv", index=False)
    print(df.to_string(index=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    {"brute": brute, "hand": hand, "repro": repro, "merge": merge}[sys.argv[1]]()

"""Step 2 diagnostics (A7 watch-time accounting, D1-D7). No model is built here."""
import json
import time

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import psutil

from src import io_utils as io
from src.join import INTERACTIONS_PATH, load_views_dedup
from src.labels import build_targets, iso_week_start, n_distinct_shows

np.random.seed(42)
T0 = time.perf_counter()
OUT = io.ROOT / "outputs"
FIG = OUT / "figures"
DPI = 150
BLUE, ORANGE, GREY, RED = "#3b6ea5", "#e08a2c", "#bbbbbb", "#c0392b"
CAT_EN = {"Детям": "Kids", "Сериалы": "Series", "Фильмы": "Films", "Развлечения": "Entertainment",
          "Инфо": "Info", "Познавательное": "Educational", "Другое": "Other", "Спорт": "Sport"}
summary = {}


def savefig(fig, name):
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(FIG / name, dpi=DPI)
    plt.close(fig)


inter = pd.read_parquet(INTERACTIONS_PATH)
sub_users = io.load_submission().user_id.values
wt = pd.read_parquet(io.CACHE / "watchtime_per_user.parquet")
views, _ = load_views_dedup()
all_users = np.sort(views.user_id.unique())
W11, W21, W25, W31 = (pd.Timestamp(iso_week_start(w)) for w in (11, 21, 25, 31))
GROUPS = {"all_users": all_users, "submission_users": sub_users}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ A7 watch-time accounting
rows = []
for g, us in GROUPS.items():
    w = wt[wt.user_id.isin(us)].sum(numeric_only=True)
    double = w.labelled + w.unlabelled - w.covered_by_union
    gap = w.total - w.absent_channel - w.covered_by_union
    parts = [("(i) labelled airings (tv_show_id != 0)", w.labelled),
             ("(ii) unlabelled airings (tv_show_id = 0)", w.unlabelled),
             ("(iii) channels absent from schedules", w.absent_channel),
             ("(iv) gaps, not covered by any airing", gap),
             ("correction: seconds counted twice in (i)+(ii) where airings overlap", -double)]
    for name, s in parts:
        rows.append({"group": g, "bucket": name, "seconds": int(s), "share": s / w.total})
    rows.append({"group": g, "bucket": "TOTAL merged watched seconds", "seconds": int(w.total), "share": 1.0})
acct = pd.DataFrame(rows)
assert np.allclose(acct[acct.bucket != "TOTAL merged watched seconds"].groupby("group").seconds.sum(),
                   acct[acct.bucket == "TOTAL merged watched seconds"].set_index("group").seconds)
acct.to_csv(OUT / "watchtime_accounting.csv", index=False)
print(acct.to_string(index=False))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.8))
names = {"(i) labelled airings (tv_show_id != 0)": ("labelled airings", BLUE),
         "(ii) unlabelled airings (tv_show_id = 0)": ("unlabelled airings (tv_show_id = 0)", GREY),
         "(iii) channels absent from schedules": ("channels absent from schedules", ORANGE),
         "(iv) gaps, not covered by any airing": ("schedule gaps", RED)}
for i, g in enumerate(GROUPS):
    left = 0
    for b, (lab, col) in names.items():
        s = acct[(acct.group == g) & (acct.bucket == b)].share.iloc[0]
        ax.barh(i, s, left=left, color=col, label=lab if i == 0 else None)
        if s > 0.03:
            ax.text(left + s / 2, i, f"{s:.1%}", ha="center", va="center", color="white", fontsize=10)
        left += s
ax.set_yticks([0, 1], ["all users (4,914)", "submission users (1,260)"])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set(title="Where merged watch time falls (weeks 11-30)", xlabel="Share of merged watched seconds")
ax.legend(loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.3), ncol=4, fontsize=9, frameon=False)
savefig(fig, "13_watchtime_accounting.png")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ D1 threshold sensitivity
train = inter[(inter.airing_start >= W11) & (inter.airing_start < W31)]
summary["labelled_pairs_weeks_11_30"] = len(train)
summary["labelled_pairs_week10"] = int((inter.airing_start < W11).sum())
rows = []
for g, us in GROUPS.items():
    d = train[train.user_id.isin(us)]
    for thr in [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0]:
        q = d[d.frac >= thr]
        nds = q.groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.nunique()
        rows.append({"group": g, "thr": thr, "qualifying_pairs": len(q), "distinct_users": q.user_id.nunique(),
                     "distinct_tv_show_ids": q.tv_show_id.nunique(), "users_with_ge5_shows": int((nds >= 5).sum())})
ts = pd.DataFrame(rows)
ts.to_csv(OUT / "threshold_sensitivity.csv", index=False)
print(ts.to_string(index=False))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.hist(train.frac, bins=100, range=(0, 1), color=BLUE)
ax.axvline(0.8, color=RED, ls="--", label="threshold 0.8")
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set(title="Screen-time fraction of labelled (user, airing) pairs, weeks 11-30",
       xlabel="frac = watched seconds / airing duration", ylabel="Number of pairs (log)")
ax.legend(); savefig(fig, "08_frac_hist.png")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.8))
for g, col in zip(GROUPS, [BLUE, ORANGE]):
    t = ts[ts.group == g]
    axes[0].plot(t.thr, t.qualifying_pairs, "o-", color=col, label=g.replace("_", " "))
    axes[1].plot(t.thr, t.users_with_ge5_shows, "o-", color=col, label=g.replace("_", " "))
axes[0].set(title="Qualifying (user, airing) pairs vs threshold", xlabel="Screen-time threshold",
            ylabel="Qualifying pairs (weeks 11-30)")
axes[1].set(title="Users with >= 5 distinct qualifying shows vs threshold", xlabel="Screen-time threshold",
            ylabel="Users")
for ax in axes:
    ax.axvline(0.8, color=GREY, ls=":"); ax.legend()
savefig(fig, "09_threshold_sensitivity.png")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ D2 per ISO week
q8 = inter[inter.frac >= 0.8]
vw = pd.Series(views.v_start.values.astype("datetime64[s]")).dt.isocalendar().week.values
active = pd.Series(views.user_id.values).groupby(vw).nunique()
wk = pd.DataFrame({"iso_week": range(10, 31)})
wk["qualifying_pairs"] = wk.iso_week.map(q8.groupby("iso_week").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
wk["active_users_viewlog"] = wk.iso_week.map(active).fillna(0).astype(int)
wk["qualifying_users"] = wk.iso_week.map(q8.groupby("iso_week").user_id.nunique()).fillna(0).astype(int)
wk.to_csv(OUT / "weekly_qualifying.csv", index=False)
print(wk.to_string(index=False))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
ax.plot(wk.iso_week, wk.active_users_viewlog, "o-", color=GREY, label="active users (any view)")
ax.plot(wk.iso_week, wk.qualifying_users, "o-", color=BLUE, label="users with >= 1 qualifying airing")
ax.set(title="Weekly activity (ISO weeks 10-30, threshold 0.8)", xlabel="ISO week of airing / view start",
       ylabel="Users")
ax2 = ax.twinx()
ax2.bar(wk.iso_week, wk.qualifying_pairs, color=ORANGE, alpha=0.3, label="qualifying pairs (right axis)")
ax2.set_ylabel("Qualifying (user, airing) pairs")
h1, l1 = ax.get_legend_handles_labels(); h2, l2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(h1 + h2, l1 + l2, loc="lower left")
ax.set_xticks(wk.iso_week)
savefig(fig, "10_weekly_qualifying.png")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ D3 distinct qualifying shows per user
t_all = build_targets(inter, W11, W31, 0.8)
nds = n_distinct_shows(t_all)
rows, hist = [], {}
for g, us in GROUPS.items():
    n = nds.reindex(us).fillna(0).astype(int)
    hist[g] = n
    rows.append({"group": g, "users": len(n), "users_0_shows": int((n == 0).sum()), "users_ge1": int((n >= 1).sum()),
                 "users_ge5": int((n >= 5).sum()), "median_shows": float(n.median()), "p90_shows": float(n.quantile(.9)),
                 "max_shows": int(n.max())})
nd = pd.DataFrame(rows)
nd.to_csv(OUT / "n_distinct_shows_summary.csv", index=False)
pd.DataFrame({g: h.value_counts().sort_index() for g, h in hist.items()}).fillna(0).astype(int) \
    .rename_axis("n_distinct_shows").reset_index().to_csv(OUT / "n_distinct_shows_distribution.csv", index=False)
print(nd.to_string(index=False))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
mx = int(hist["all_users"].quantile(0.99))
bins = np.arange(0, mx + 2) - 0.5
for g, col in zip(GROUPS, [BLUE, ORANGE]):
    ax.hist(hist[g].clip(upper=mx), bins=bins, color=col, alpha=0.6, label=f"{g.replace('_', ' ')} (n={len(hist[g]):,})")
ax.axvline(4.5, color=RED, ls="--", label="5 shows (top-5 needs >= 5)")
ax.set(title=f"Distinct qualifying shows per user (weeks 11-30, thr 0.8; values >= {mx} pooled at {mx})",
       xlabel="Number of distinct tv_show_ids with >= 1 qualifying airing", ylabel="Users")
ax.legend(); savefig(fig, "11_n_distinct_shows.png")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ D4 candidate windows
WINDOWS = {"W1 weeks 21-30": (W21, W31), "W2 weeks 25-30": (W25, W31), "W3 weeks 11-20": (W11, W21)}
targets = {k: build_targets(inter, s, e, 0.8) for k, (s, e) in WINDOWS.items()}
rows = []
for k, (s, e) in WINDOWS.items():
    n = n_distinct_shows(targets[k])
    for g, us in GROUPS.items():
        m = n.reindex(us).fillna(0)
        rows.append({"window": k, "start": s.date(), "end_exclusive": e.date(), "group": g, "users": len(us),
                     "ge1_shows": int((m >= 1).sum()), "ge3_shows": int((m >= 3).sum()), "ge5_shows": int((m >= 5).sum())})
cw = pd.DataFrame(rows)
cw.to_csv(OUT / "candidate_window_target_counts.csv", index=False)
print(cw.to_string(index=False))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ D5 repeat consumption W1 vs W3
sched = pd.concat([io.load_schedule("11-20"), io.load_schedule("21-30")], ignore_index=True)
lab_sched = sched[(sched.tv_show_id != 0) & (sched.duration > 0)]
ids_1120 = set(io.load_schedule("11-20").query("tv_show_id != 0").tv_show_id.unique())
w1 = targets["W1 weeks 21-30"]
n1 = n_distinct_shows(w1)
w3 = inter[(inter.airing_start >= W11) & (inter.airing_start < W21)]
w3_q = set(zip(w3.user_id[w3.frac >= 0.8], w3.tv_show_id[w3.frac >= 0.8]))
w3_any = set(zip(w3.user_id, w3.tv_show_id))
rows = []
for g, us in GROUPS.items():
    elig = n1[(n1 >= 5) & n1.index.isin(us)].index
    top5 = w1[(w1["rank"] <= 5) & w1.user_id.isin(elig)]
    pairs = list(zip(top5.user_id, top5.tv_show_id))
    q = np.array([p in w3_q for p in pairs]); a = np.array([p in w3_any for p in pairs])
    in1120 = top5.tv_show_id.isin(ids_1120).values
    rows.append({"group": g, "users_ge5_in_W1": len(elig), "top5_pairs": len(pairs),
                 "share_pairs_qualifying_in_W3": q.mean(), "share_pairs_any_watch_in_W3": a.mean(),
                 "distinct_target_shows": top5.tv_show_id.nunique(),
                 "distinct_target_shows_with_0_airings_in_11-20_schedule": top5.tv_show_id[~in1120].nunique(),
                 "share_pairs_show_absent_from_11-20_schedule": 1 - in1120.mean()})
rc = pd.DataFrame(rows)
rc.to_csv(OUT / "repeat_consumption_W1_vs_W3.csv", index=False)
print(rc.T.to_string())

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ D6 popularity and categories
titles = (lab_sched.groupby(["tv_show_id", "tv_show_title"]).size().reset_index(name="n")
          .sort_values(["tv_show_id", "n"], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates("tv_show_id")
          .set_index("tv_show_id").tv_show_title)
cat = lab_sched.drop_duplicates("tv_show_id").set_index("tv_show_id").tv_show_category
q11 = train[train.frac >= 0.8]
pop = q11.groupby("tv_show_id").agg(distinct_users=("user_id", "nunique"), qualifying_pairs=("user_id", "size"))
pop = pop.sort_values(["distinct_users", "qualifying_pairs"], ascending=False).head(20)
pop["title_most_frequent"] = titles.reindex(pop.index).values
pop["category"] = cat.reindex(pop.index).values
pop["category_en"] = pop.category.map(CAT_EN)
pop.reset_index().to_csv(OUT / "top20_shows_by_distinct_users.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(pop.to_string())
cs = pd.DataFrame({"share_of_qualifying_pairs": q11.tv_show_id.map(cat).value_counts(normalize=True),
                   "share_of_labelled_airings_11_30": lab_sched.tv_show_category.value_counts(normalize=True)}).fillna(0)
cs = cs.sort_values("share_of_labelled_airings_11_30")
cs.index = [f"{CAT_EN.get(c, c)} ({c})" for c in cs.index]
cs.rename_axis("category").reset_index().to_csv(OUT / "category_share_qualifying_vs_schedule.csv", index=False,
                                                 encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(cs.to_string())
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
y = np.arange(len(cs))
ax.barh(y - 0.2, cs.share_of_labelled_airings_11_30, height=0.4, color=GREY, label="labelled schedule airings")
ax.barh(y + 0.2, cs.share_of_qualifying_pairs, height=0.4, color=BLUE, label="qualifying (user, airing) pairs")
ax.set_yticks(y, cs.index)
ax.set(title="Category share: what airs vs what is watched (frac >= 0.8, weeks 11-30)", xlabel="Share")
ax.legend(loc="lower right"); savefig(fig, "12_category_share.png")

mi = psutil.Process().memory_info()
summary["runtime_seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - T0, 1)
summary["peak_memory_mb"] = round(getattr(mi, "peak_wset", mi.rss) / 1024**2)
(OUT / "diagnostics_step2_stats.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
print(summary)

w3_q = set(zip(w3.user_id[w3.frac >= 0.8], w3.tv_show_id[w3.frac >= 0.8]))
w3_any = set(zip(w3.user_id, w3.tv_show_id))
rows = []
for g, us in GROUPS.items():
    elig = n1[(n1 >= 5) & n1.index.isin(us)].index
    top5 = w1[(w1["rank"] <= 5) & w1.user_id.isin(elig)]
    pairs = list(zip(top5.user_id, top5.tv_show_id))
    q = np.array([p in w3_q for p in pairs]); a = np.array([p in w3_any for p in pairs])
    in1120 = top5.tv_show_id.isin(ids_1120).values
    rows.append({"group": g, "users_ge5_in_W1": len(elig), "top5_pairs": len(pairs),
                 "share_pairs_qualifying_in_W3": q.mean(), "share_pairs_any_watch_in_W3": a.mean(),
                 "distinct_target_shows": top5.tv_show_id.nunique(),
                 "distinct_target_shows_with_0_airings_in_11-20_schedule": top5.tv_show_id[~in1120].nunique(),
                 "share_pairs_show_absent_from_11-20_schedule": 1 - in1120.mean()})
rc = pd.DataFrame(rows)
rc.to_csv(OUT / "repeat_consumption_W1_vs_W3.csv", index=False)
print(rc.T.to_string())

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ D6 popularity and categories
titles = (lab_sched.groupby(["tv_show_id", "tv_show_title"]).size().reset_index(name="n")
          .sort_values(["tv_show_id", "n"], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates("tv_show_id")
          .set_index("tv_show_id").tv_show_title)
cat = lab_sched.drop_duplicates("tv_show_id").set_index("tv_show_id").tv_show_category
q11 = train[train.frac >= 0.8]
pop = q11.groupby("tv_show_id").agg(distinct_users=("user_id", "nunique"), qualifying_pairs=("user_id", "size"))
pop = pop.sort_values(["distinct_users", "qualifying_pairs"], ascending=False).head(20)
pop["title_most_frequent"] = titles.reindex(pop.index).values
pop["category"] = cat.reindex(pop.index).values
pop["category_en"] = pop.category.map(CAT_EN)
pop.reset_index().to_csv(OUT / "top20_shows_by_distinct_users.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(pop.to_string())
cs = pd.DataFrame({"share_of_qualifying_pairs": q11.tv_show_id.map(cat).value_counts(normalize=True),
                   "share_of_labelled_airings_11_30": lab_sched.tv_show_category.value_counts(normalize=True)}).fillna(0)
cs = cs.sort_values("share_of_labelled_airings_11_30")
cs.index = [f"{CAT_EN.get(c, c)} ({c})" for c in cs.index]
cs.rename_axis("category").reset_index().to_csv(OUT / "category_share_qualifying_vs_schedule.csv", index=False,
                                                 encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(cs.to_string())
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
y = np.arange(len(cs))
ax.barh(y - 0.2, cs.share_of_labelled_airings_11_30, height=0.4, color=GREY, label="labelled schedule airings")
ax.barh(y + 0.2, cs.share_of_qualifying_pairs, height=0.4, color=BLUE, label="qualifying (user, airing) pairs")
ax.set_yticks(y, cs.index)
ax.set(title="Category share: what airs vs what is watched (frac >= 0.8, weeks 11-30)", xlabel="Share")
ax.legend(loc="lower right"); savefig(fig, "12_category_share.png")

mi = psutil.Process().memory_info()
summary["runtime_seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - T0, 1)
summary["peak_memory_mb"] = round(getattr(mi, "peak_wset", mi.rss) / 1024**2)
(OUT / "diagnostics_step2_stats.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
print(summary)

## Step 2: join, interactions, label function (2026-10-30)

### What was run
1. `python -m src.join`: dedup, merge, overlap join, aggregation -> `cache/interactions.parquet`, `cache/watchtime_per_user.parquet`, `outputs/join_stats.json` (stdout `outputs/join_stdout_run1.txt`).
2. `python -m src.verify_step2 hand | brute | repro | merge` (C2, C1, C3, C4) -> `verify_hand_examples.txt`, `verify_bruteforce.csv` (+ `_stdout.txt`), `verify_reproducibility.csv`, `merge_sensitivity.csv`.
3. `python -m src.diagnostics_step2` (A7, D1-D7) -> CSVs below, figures 08-13, `diagnostics_step2_stats.json`, `diagnostics_step2_stdout.txt`.
4. Ad-hoc check of schedule labelling per ISO week -> `schedule_labelling_per_week.csv`.
The 31-42 schedule was not loaded. No model was built.

### Rules used
- **View end** = start_time + duration (seconds), not stop_time/end_time (DST: 117 rows differ by +3600 s). All times are naive local wall-clock, converted to integer seconds.
- **Dedup**: exact duplicate view rows dropped (17).
- **Merge**: within (user_id, vsetv_id), views sorted by v_start; a new block starts when v_start > running max of earlier v_end (touching views, v_start == previous end, are merged). Views on different channels are never merged.
- **Airings**: schedules 11-20 + 21-30 concatenated; duration <= 0 dropped (1); duplicated (channel_id, start_time) dropped keeping the first (0 left after the previous rule: the only duplicate pair, channel 644 at 2020-03-29 04:00, consisted of the 0-second airing and a 1,800-second airing, so removing the 0-second one resolved it). All airings incl. tv_show_id = 0 enter the join; only labelled ones are saved.
- **Overlap join**: per channel, airings sorted by start; candidates for view [vs, ve) are airings from the first index where the running max of airing ends > vs up to the last airing with start < ve (np.searchsorted on both), expanded with np.repeat, then filtered on overlap > 0. Using the running max keeps it correct where airings overlap slightly.
- **frac** = watched_seconds / scheduled airing duration. Not filtered in the cache.
- **Targets** (`src/labels.build_targets`): airings with start <= airing_start < end and frac >= thr count. Per (user, show): n_qualifying_airings, watched_seconds_total (sum over the qualifying airings only). Rank by n_qualifying_airings desc, then watched_seconds_total desc, then tv_show_id asc. **Tie-break is our convention**; the competition's own tie handling is unobservable. Full ranked list returned. Week starts by ISO week (`iso_week_start(21)` = 2020-05-18, `iso_week_start(31)` = 2020-07-27).
- **tv_show_id = 0** is dropped as an item but its watched seconds are counted as watching context in the accounting (A7).

### interactions.parquet columns (3,014,110 rows, 31.5 MB, 4,895 users, 4,363 shows)
| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| user_id | uint64 | viewer |
| tv_show_id | int64 | labelled series id (never 0) |
| channel_id | int32 | = vsetv_id |
| airing_start | datetime64[s] | scheduled start, naive local time |
| airing_duration | int32 | scheduled duration, s |
| watched_seconds | int64 | sum of overlaps of the user's merged views with the airing (> 0) |
| frac | float64 | watched_seconds / airing_duration, in (0, 1] |
| iso_week | int16 | ISO week of airing_start |

### Key numbers
- Views: 5,821,987 raw -> 5,821,970 after dedup -> 5,441,780 merged blocks (380,190 rows absorbed; 187,000 blocks built from >= 2 raw views). Watched seconds 8,619,206,214 -> 8,502,989,921 (merge removed 116,216,293 s = 1.348% double counting).
- Airings: 2,148,629 in 11-20 + 21-30 -> 2,148,628 kept; 237,118 labelled (11.04%).
- frac max = 1.0; pairs with frac > 1 + 1e-9: 0 (assert passes). Pairs with frac == 1: 421,600.
- Labelled pairs: 3,014,110; airing in ISO week 10: 0; airing in week 31 (>= 2020-07-27): 0 (no view reaches 07-27, so none dropped). 20.30% of pairs have frac >= 0.8.
- **Watch-time accounting** (`watchtime_accounting.csv`, fig 13), all users / submission users: labelled 52.89% / 51.44%; unlabelled (tv_show_id = 0) 41.15% / 42.58%; channels absent from schedules 1.36% / 1.44%; schedule gaps 4.60% / 4.53%; double counting where airings overlap: 4,746 s / 1,808 s (subtracted). Total 8,502,989,921 s / 2,887,792,159 s.
- **Threshold sensitivity** (weeks 11-30, `threshold_sensitivity.csv`): thr 0.8 gives 611,748 qualifying pairs, 4,841 users, 3,866 shows, 4,633 users with >= 5 shows; submission users 196,134 pairs, 1,256 users, 1,241 with >= 5 shows. At thr 0.5 / 1.0: 938,121 / 421,600 pairs.
- **Distinct qualifying shows per user** (thr 0.8, weeks 11-30): all users median 32, p90 105, max 545, 73 users with 0; submission users median 40, p90 116.1, max 329, 4 with 0, **1,241 of 1,260 with >= 5**.
- **Candidate windows** (`candidate_window_target_counts.csv`), users with >= 1 / >= 3 / >= 5 shows:
  W1 weeks 21-30: all 4,643 / 4,333 / 4,030; submission 1,238 / 1,206 / 1,150.
  W2 weeks 25-30: all 4,569 / 4,193 / 3,757; submission 1,233 / 1,188 / 1,103.
  W3 weeks 11-20: all 4,737 / 4,553 / 4,349; submission 1,242 / 1,222 / 1,197.
- **Repeat consumption** (`repeat_consumption_W1_vs_W3.csv`): users with >= 5 W1 shows: 4,030 (submission 1,150); of their 20,150 (5,750) top-5 (user, show) pairs, 50.82% (56.64%) had a qualifying airing in W3 and 65.32% (71.03%) any watched seconds in W3. 396 of 1,484 distinct W1 target shows (submission: 186 of 774) have no labelled airing in the 11-20 schedule; they make up 7.43% (6.26%) of the target pairs.
- **Popularity** (`top20_shows_by_distinct_users.csv`): #1 ТСН (2400480, Info) 3,995 users; #2 Факты (240081, Info) 3,808. Info is 25.23% of qualifying pairs but 3.78% of labelled airings; Kids 25.15% vs 39.83%; Series 10.27% vs 27.18% (`category_share_qualifying_vs_schedule.csv`, fig 12).
- **Weekly** (`weekly_qualifying.csv`, fig 10): qualifying pairs per week are 26k-49k except weeks 25 / 26 / 27: 13,732 / 9,948 / 10,933. Schedule labelling in those weeks is normal (labelled share 11.3-11.7%, `schedule_labelling_per_week.csv`), so the dip comes from the viewing side (labelled watched hours about 54k per week in weeks 23-24 vs 29.7k / 24.7k / 28.1k). Week 27 contains the missing day 2020-07-03.

### Verification evidence
- **C1 brute force**: 30 users (seed 42; 11 submission users; includes the owner of the 342,145 s view, and the max number of airings spanned by one merged view is 209). Pure-Python dedup + merge + double loop over all airings of the channel. 19,767 labelled (user, airing) pairs compared, **0 mismatches**, same pair sets. Runtime 124.4 s.
- **C2 hand examples** (`verify_hand_examples.txt`, submission user 10976640701901441368, csv module only): A frac >= 0.8: airing ch 7 2020-03-12 15:20 (6,600 s), 4,361 + 1,156 = 5,517 s, frac 0.835909. B frac < 0.8: ch 3 2020-03-09 09:10 (8,400 s), 8 views, 3,113 s, frac 0.370595. C merged: ch 3 2020-03-29 11:40 (10,500 s), a 77 s view lies inside a 10,838 s view; merged 7,046 s (frac 0.671048), unmerged would give 7,123 s. All three MATCH the pipeline.
- **C3 reproducibility**: two builds from an empty cache (incl. CSV parsing): 57.6 s and 69.0 s wall; 3,014,110 rows each; identical SHA-256 98a7a80a...be72bd; assert_frame_equal passes.
- **C4 merge sensitivity** (full data, `merge_sensitivity.csv`): pairs with frac >= 0.8: merged 611,748 vs unmerged 615,965 (+4,217, +0.69%); without merging, 24,005 pairs exceed frac 1 (max 31.13) and labelled watched seconds rise by 77,964,905.

### Runtime and memory
- join (warm parquet cache): 38.7 s, peak 1,078 MB; from empty cache (incl. CSV parse): 59.0 s inside build, peak 1,471 MB.
- merge-sensitivity builds 33.3 s / 35.2 s; brute force 124.4 s; diagnostics 35.5 s, peak 1,187 MB. All far below the 4 GB budget.

### Bugs, failure cases and fixes
1. **Brute-force sampling bug (float64 user ids).** `np.array(sorted(set_of_python_ints))` turned the 1,260 submission ids into float64 because they exceed int64 range; rng.choice then produced rounded ids such as 14399299985567565824 that exist in no file. The first C1 run therefore "verified" 0 views for those users (vacuous pass). Fixed by sampling from the uint64 column directly and asserting every picked id exists in the view log; rerun: 30 real users, 0 mismatches. Lesson: never route these ids through a numpy array built from Python ints.
2. **Reproducibility script deleted its own evidence.** The "from scratch" step removed `cache/*.parquet`, including run 1's saved copy, so assert_frame_equal crashed (the hashes already matched). Copies now go to `cache/repro/`.
3. **Duplicate airing = zero-length airing.** Step 1's single duplicated (channel, start) pair is the 0-second airing on channel 644, so the dedup rule drops 0 rows after the duration rule. Order of the rules matters only in this sense.
4. **Pandas index after concat** (ad-hoc weekly check): a lambda aggregation failed on duplicate index labels after concatenating the two schedules; fixed with `ignore_index=True`.
5. Plot fixes: fig 10 legend overlapped bars (moved below, lines drawn above bars); fig 11 was cramped (split into a 0-30 zoom and a full-range panel, step outlines).
6. Encoding: printing Cyrillic to the Windows console failed with cp1252; scripts are run with `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8`, CSVs with Cyrillic are written as UTF-8 with BOM.
EOF
