"""Shared evaluation protocol: every method imports get_split() and pad_with_popularity().

Split "val":  train = interactions with airing_start in ISO weeks 11-20 [2020-03-09, 2020-05-18);
              truth = rank <= 5 of build_targets(inter, W21, W31, thr=0.8);
              users = users with >= 5 distinct qualifying shows in the target window.
Split "test": train = all interactions (weeks 11-30); users = the 1,260 template users (template order).
Pool: labelled tv_show_ids (tv_show_id != 0, duration > 0) with >= 1 airing whose start lies inside the
      target window (val [W21, W31) from schedule 21-30; test [W31, W43) from schedule 31-42).
The 31-42 schedule is used only for the test pool and show metadata, never joined to viewing.
User ids are kept as uint64 (and the template's original strings for the test split).
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from functools import lru_cache

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from src import io_utils as io
from src.join import INTERACTIONS_PATH
from src.labels import build_targets, iso_week_start, n_distinct_shows

THR = 0.8
K = 5
W = {w: pd.Timestamp(iso_week_start(w)) for w in (11, 17, 21, 26, 27, 31, 43)}
META_COLS = {"tv_show_title": "title", "tv_show_category": "category", "tv_show_genre_1": "genre_1",
             "tv_show_genre_2": "genre_2", "tv_show_genre_3": "genre_3", "year_of_production": "year",
             "director": "director", "actors": "actors"}


@dataclass
class Split:
    kind: str
    train: pd.DataFrame
    pool: np.ndarray                 # sorted int64 tv_show_ids
    users: np.ndarray                # uint64, evaluation / submission order
    sub_mask: np.ndarray             # bool, aligned with users
    meta: pd.DataFrame               # index tv_show_id
    train_start: pd.Timestamp
    train_end: pd.Timestamp          # exclusive
    truth: dict = field(default_factory=dict)       # int(user) -> list of 5 ids (val only)
    user_str: list = field(default_factory=list)    # original template strings (test only)
    info: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def load_interactions() -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.read_parquet(INTERACTIONS_PATH)


def labelled_airings(periods) -> pd.DataFrame:
    parts = []
    for p in periods:
        s = io.load_schedule(p)
        s = s[(s.tv_show_id != 0) & (s.duration > 0)]
        parts.append(s[["channel_id", "start_time", "duration", "tv_show_id", *META_COLS]])
    return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)


def build_meta(lab: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Per tv_show_id: most frequent non-null value of each metadata column (ties: smallest value)."""
    meta = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(np.sort(lab.tv_show_id.unique()), name="tv_show_id"))
    for c, name in META_COLS.items():
        m = (lab.groupby(["tv_show_id", c]).size().reset_index(name="n")
             .sort_values(["tv_show_id", "n", c], ascending=[True, False, True])
             .drop_duplicates("tv_show_id").set_index("tv_show_id")[c])
        meta[name] = m.reindex(meta.index)
    meta["n_airings_schedules"] = lab.groupby("tv_show_id").size().reindex(meta.index)
    return meta


def submission_users():
    """Template user ids as original strings (order kept) and as uint64 (round-trip asserted)."""
    import csv
    with open(io.DATA / io.SUBMISSION_FILE, newline="") as f:
        strs = [r["user_id"] for r in csv.DictReader(f)]
    u = np.array([int(s) for s in strs], dtype=np.uint64)  # explicit dtype: no float coercion
    assert [str(int(x)) for x in u] == strs
    return strs, u


def pad_with_popularity(lst, pop_ranking, k=K):
    """Deduplicate lst (keep order), truncate to k, then fill from pop_ranking skipping duplicates."""
    out, seen = [], set()
    for x in list(lst) + list(pop_ranking):
        x = int(x)
        if x not in seen:
            out.append(x)
            seen.add(x)
        if len(out) == k:
            break
    return out


def pool_ids(lab: pd.DataFrame, start, end) -> np.ndarray:
    m = (lab.start_time >= start) & (lab.start_time < end)
    return np.sort(lab.loc[m, "tv_show_id"].unique()).astype(np.int64)


@lru_cache(maxsize=2)
def get_split(kind: str) -> Split:
    inter = load_interactions()
    sub_strs, sub_u = submission_users()
    if kind == "val":
        lab = labelled_airings(["11-20", "21-30"])
        train = inter[(inter.airing_start >= W[11]) & (inter.airing_start < W[21])].reset_index(drop=True)
        pool = pool_ids(lab, W[21], W[31])
        lab2130 = lab[lab.start_time >= W[21]]
        info = {"pool_size": len(pool),
                "pool_size_if_all_21_30_airings_from_W21": int(lab2130.tv_show_id.nunique())}
        tg = build_targets(inter, W[21], W[31], THR)
        nds = n_distinct_shows(tg)
        users = np.sort(nds[nds >= K].index.values.astype(np.uint64))
        top = tg[(tg["rank"] <= K) & tg.user_id.isin(users)]
        truth = {int(u): g.tv_show_id.tolist() for u, g in top.groupby("user_id", sort=True)}
        assert all(len(v) == K for v in truth.values()) and len(truth) == len(users)
        missing = {t for v in truth.values() for t in v} - set(pool.tolist())
        assert not missing, f"truth ids outside pool: {missing}"
        sp = Split("val", train, pool, users, np.isin(users, sub_u), build_meta(lab), W[11], W[21],
                   truth=truth, info=info)
    elif kind == "test":
        lab = labelled_airings(["11-20", "21-30", "31-42"])
        train = inter[(inter.airing_start >= W[11]) & (inter.airing_start < W[31])].reset_index(drop=True)
        pool = pool_ids(lab, W[31], W[43])
        info = {"pool_size": len(pool),
                "pool_size_if_all_31_42_airings": int(lab[lab.start_time >= W[31]].tv_show_id.nunique())}
        sp = Split("test", train, pool, sub_u, np.ones(len(sub_u), bool), build_meta(lab), W[11], W[31],
                   user_str=sub_strs, info=info)
    else:
        raise ValueError(kind)
    sp.info.update({"train_rows": len(sp.train), "users": len(sp.users), "sub_users": int(sp.sub_mask.sum())})
    return sp


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for k in ["val", "test"]:
        s = get_split(k)
        print(k, s.info, "train", s.train_start.date(), "->", s.train_end.date(), "(exclusive)")

"""Write and validate a Kaggle submission file in the template's row order."""
import csv

from src import io_utils as io

SUB_DIR = io.ROOT / "outputs" / "submissions"
HEADER = ["user_id", "tv_show_id"]


def template_users():
    with open(io.DATA / io.SUBMISSION_FILE, newline="") as f:
        rd = csv.reader(f)
        header = next(rd)
        users = [r[0] for r in rd]
    assert header == HEADER, header
    return users


def validate(rows, pool):
    """rows: list of (user_str, [5 ints]). Asserts every rule and prints a checklist."""
    tmpl = template_users()
    pool = set(int(x) for x in pool)
    checks = {
        "1,260 rows": len(rows) == 1260,
        "same users and order as template": [u for u, _ in rows] == tmpl,
        "each row exactly 5 distinct integers": all(len(r) == 5 and len(set(r)) == 5 and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in r)
                                                    for _, r in rows),
        "no zeros": all(0 not in r for _, r in rows),
        "all ids in test pool": all(set(r) <= pool for _, r in rows),
    }
    for k, ok in checks.items():
        print(f"  [{'OK' if ok else 'FAIL'}] {k}")
    assert all(checks.values()), checks


def write_submission(name, recs, split):
    """recs: original user string -> list of 5 ids. Writes outputs/submissions/<name>.csv."""
    rows = [(u, [int(x) for x in recs[u]]) for u in split.user_str]
    print(f"validating {name}:")
    validate(rows, split.pool)
    SUB_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = SUB_DIR / f"{name}.csv"
    with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
        f.write(",".join(HEADER) + "\n")
        for u, r in rows:
            f.write(f"{u},{' '.join(map(str, r))}\n")
    with open(path, newline="") as f:
        lines = f.read().splitlines()
    assert lines[0] == "user_id,tv_show_id" and len(lines) == 1261
    print(f"  [OK] exact header; wrote {path.name}; first 3 rows:")
    for line in lines[1:4]:
        print("   ", line)
    return path

"""Step 3: validation of baselines, ceiling/robustness/breakdown, example users, test submissions.

Run: python -m src.run_step3     (no learned model is built here)
"""
import hashlib
import json
import time

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import psutil

from src import io_utils as io
from src.baselines import PF_VARIANTS, POP_VARIANTS, pf_recommend, pf_scores, pop_recommend, popularity
from src.evaluate import ap_at_k, bootstrap_ci, map_at_k, paired_bootstrap_diff
from src.labels import build_targets, n_distinct_shows
from src.make_submission import write_submission
from src.protocol import K, THR, W, get_split, labelled_airings

np.random.seed(42)
T0 = time.perf_counter()
OUT, FIG = io.ROOT / "outputs", io.ROOT / "outputs" / "figures"
DPI = 150
BLUE, ORANGE, GREY, RED, GREEN = "#3b6ea5", "#e08a2c", "#9a9a9a", "#c0392b", "#4a9a5b"
summary = {}


def savefig(fig, name):
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(FIG / name, dpi=DPI)
    plt.close(fig)


def mean_ci(ap):
    lo, hi = bootstrap_ci(ap)
    return float(ap.mean()), lo, hi


# ====================================================================== validation split
sp = get_split("val")
print("VAL split:", sp.info)
summary["val_split"] = sp.info
SUB = set(int(u) for u in sp.users[sp.sub_mask])
truth = sp.truth


def split_pop(ap):
    return {"ALL": ap, "SUB": ap[ap.index.isin(SUB)]}


def evaluate(name, family, recs, padded, t0):
    _, ap = map_at_k(recs, truth)
    row = {"method": name, "family": family}
    for pop, a in split_pop(ap).items():
        m, lo, hi = mean_ci(a)
        row.update({f"map5_{pop}": m, f"ci_lo_{pop}": lo, f"ci_hi_{pop}": hi, f"n_{pop}": len(a),
                    f"mean_padded_{pop}": float(np.mean([padded[u] for u in a.index]))})
    row["runtime_s"] = round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 2)
    return row, ap


rows, APS, RECS, POPRANK = [], {}, {}, {}
for v in POP_VARIANTS:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    POPRANK[v] = popularity(sp.train, sp.pool, v, sp.train_end)
    RECS[v], padded = pop_recommend(sp.users, POPRANK[v])
    r, APS[v] = evaluate(v, "popularity baseline", RECS[v], padded, t0)
    rows.append(r)
    print(r)
res = pd.DataFrame(rows)
res["avg_all_sub"] = (res.map5_ALL + res.map5_SUB) / 2
POP = res.sort_values(["avg_all_sub", "method"], ascending=[False, True]).method.iloc[0]
print("chosen popularity baseline (best mean of ALL and SUB MAP@5):", POP)

for v in PF_VARIANTS:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    RECS[v], padded = pf_recommend(sp.train, sp.pool, sp.users, v, POPRANK[POP], sp.train_end)
    r, APS[v] = evaluate(v, f"personal-frequency baseline (padded with {POP})", RECS[v], padded, t0)
    rows.append(r)
    print(r)
res = pd.DataFrame(rows)
res["avg_all_sub"] = (res.map5_ALL + res.map5_SUB) / 2
PF = res[res.method.isin(PF_VARIANTS)].sort_values(["avg_all_sub", "method"], ascending=[False, True]).method.iloc[0]
res["chosen"] = res.method.isin([POP, PF])
res.to_csv(OUT / "baseline_results_val.csv", index=False)
print(res[["method", "map5_ALL", "ci_lo_ALL", "ci_hi_ALL", "map5_SUB", "ci_lo_SUB", "ci_hi_SUB",
           "mean_padded_ALL", "runtime_s"]].round(4).to_string(index=False))
print("chosen personal baseline:", PF)
summary.update({"chosen_pop": POP, "chosen_pf": PF})

pd_rows = []
for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
    d, lo, hi = paired_bootstrap_diff(split_pop(APS[PF])[pop], split_pop(APS[POP])[pop])
    pd_rows.append({"population": pop, "comparison": f"{PF} - {POP}", "mean_diff": d, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
    hl = [v for v in PF_VARIANTS if v != PF]
    for v in hl:
        d, lo, hi = paired_bootstrap_diff(split_pop(APS[PF])[pop], split_pop(APS[v])[pop])
        pd_rows.append({"population": pop, "comparison": f"{PF} - {v}", "mean_diff": d, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
pdiff = pd.DataFrame(pd_rows)
pdiff.to_csv(OUT / "baseline_paired_diffs_val.csv", index=False)
print(pdiff.round(5).to_string(index=False))

# ====================================================================== C4 ceiling
tr = sp.train
hist_any = tr.groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.agg(set)
hist_q = tr[tr.frac >= THR].groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.agg(set)
ids_1120 = set(labelled_airings(["11-20"]).tv_show_id.unique().tolist())
crow = []
for pop, us in [("ALL", list(truth)), ("SUB", [u for u in truth if u in SUB])]:
    in_any = in_q = absent = 0
    ap_any, ap_q = [], []
    for u in us:
        t = truth[u]
        ha = hist_any.get(np.uint64(u), set())
        hq = hist_q.get(np.uint64(u), set())
        in_any += sum(x in ha for x in t)
        in_q += sum(x in hq for x in t)
        absent += sum(x not in ids_1120 for x in t)
        dummies = [-1, -2, -3, -4, -5]
        ap_any.append(ap_at_k(([x for x in t if x in ha] + dummies)[:K], t))
        ap_q.append(ap_at_k(([x for x in t if x in hq] + dummies)[:K], t))
    n = len(us) * K
    crow.append({"population": pop, "users": len(us), "truth_pairs": n,
                 "share_truth_in_history_any_watch": in_any / n, "share_truth_in_history_qualifying": in_q / n,
                 "ceiling_map5_history_any_watch": float(np.mean(ap_any)),
                 "ceiling_map5_history_qualifying": float(np.mean(ap_q)),
                 "share_truth_shows_absent_from_11_20_schedule": absent / n,
                 f"map5_{POP}": float(split_pop(APS[POP])[pop].mean()), f"map5_{PF}": float(split_pop(APS[PF])[pop].mean())})
ceil = pd.DataFrame(crow)
ceil.to_csv(OUT / "ceiling_analysis_val.csv", index=False)
print(ceil.T.to_string())

# ====================================================================== C5 robustness
inter = __import__("src.protocol", fromlist=["load_interactions"]).load_interactions()
clean = inter[inter.iso_week.isin([21, 22, 23, 24, 28, 29, 30])]
TRUTHS = {"main: weeks 21-30": build_targets(inter, W[21], W[31], THR),
          "clean: 21-24 + 28-30 (no 25-27)": build_targets(clean, W[21], W[31], THR),
          "weeks 21-25": build_targets(inter, W[21], W[26], THR),
          "weeks 26-30": build_targets(inter, W[26], W[31], THR)}
sub_all = set(int(u) for u in get_split("test").users)
rrows = []
for name, tg in TRUTHS.items():
    nds = n_distinct_shows(tg)
    us = nds[nds >= K].index.values.astype(np.uint64)
    top = tg[(tg["rank"] <= K) & tg.user_id.isin(us)]
    tdict = {int(u): g.tv_show_id.tolist() for u, g in top.groupby("user_id")}
    assert set(x for v in tdict.values() for x in v) <= set(sp.pool.tolist())
    pf_r, _ = pf_recommend(sp.train, sp.pool, us, PF, POPRANK[POP], sp.train_end)
    pop_r, _ = pop_recommend(us, POPRANK[POP])
    for meth, recs in [(POP, pop_r), (PF, pf_r)]:
        _, ap = map_at_k(recs, tdict)
        for pop, a in [("ALL", ap), ("SUB", ap[ap.index.isin(sub_all)])]:
            m, lo, hi = mean_ci(a)
            rrows.append({"truth_window": name, "method": meth, "population": pop, "users": len(a),
                          "map5": m, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
rob = pd.DataFrame(rrows)
rob.to_csv(OUT / "robustness_target_windows_val.csv", index=False)
print(rob.round(4).to_string(index=False))

# ====================================================================== C6 breakdown
nds_train = tr[tr.frac >= THR].groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.nunique()
act = pd.Series({u: int(nds_train.get(np.uint64(u), 0)) for u in truth})
bins, labels = [-1, 4, 9, 19, 49, np.inf], ["0-4", "5-9", "10-19", "20-49", "50+"]
bucket = pd.cut(act, bins=bins, labels=labels)
brows = []
for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
    for b in labels:
        for meth in [POP, PF]:
            a = split_pop(APS[meth])[pop]
            a = a[bucket.reindex(a.index) == b]
            m, lo, hi = mean_ci(a) if len(a) else (np.nan, np.nan, np.nan)
            brows.append({"population": pop, "activity_bucket": b, "method": meth, "users": len(a),
                          "map5": m, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
bk = pd.DataFrame(brows)
bk.to_csv(OUT / "breakdown_activity_bucket_val.csv", index=False)
print(bk.round(4).to_string(index=False))

hrows = []
for meth in [POP, PF]:
    for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
        us = split_pop(APS[meth])[pop].index
        hits = np.array([[RECS[meth][u][i] in set(truth[u]) for i in range(K)] for u in us])
        for i in range(K):
            hrows.append({"method": meth, "population": pop, "rank": i + 1,
                          "hit_rate_at_rank": hits[:, i].mean(), "share_of_all_hits": hits[:, i].sum() / hits.sum(),
                          "mean_hits_per_user": hits.sum(1).mean()})
hr = pd.DataFrame(hrows)
hr.to_csv(OUT / "hit_rank_distribution_val.csv", index=False)
print(hr.round(4).to_string(index=False))

drows = []
for meth in [POP, PF]:
    for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
        a = split_pop(APS[meth])[pop]
        d = a.describe(percentiles=[.25, .5, .75, .9]).to_dict()
        d.update({"method": meth, "population": pop, "share_ap_0": float((a == 0).mean()),
                  "share_ap_1": float((a == 1).mean())})
        drows.append(d)
pd.DataFrame(drows).to_csv(OUT / "per_user_ap_distribution_val.csv", index=False)

# ====================================================================== B4 hand-computed MAP check
meta = sp.meta
lines = [f"Hand-computed AP@5 check, personal baseline {PF} (validation split)"]
cand = None
for u in sorted(SUB):
    rec, t = RECS[PF][u], set(truth[u])
    hit = [r in t for r in rec]
    if 2 <= sum(hit) <= 4 and not hit[0] or (2 <= sum(hit) <= 4 and False in hit[:max(i for i, h in enumerate(hit) if h)]):
        cand = u
        break
u = cand
rec, t = RECS[PF][u], truth[u]
lines += [f"user_id = {u} (SUB user)",
          "recommended (rank: id title [category] -> hit?):"]
for i, r in enumerate(rec, 1):
    lines.append(f"  {i}: {r} {meta.title.get(r)} [{meta.category.get(r)}] -> {'HIT' if r in t else 'miss'}")
lines.append("truth (5 ids, order irrelevant): " + ", ".join(f"{x} {meta.title.get(x)}" for x in t))
hits, terms = 0, []
for i, r in enumerate(rec, 1):
    if r in t:
        hits += 1
        lines.append(f"  rank {i}: hit #{hits} -> P@{i} = {hits}/{i} = {hits / i:.6f}")
        terms.append((hits, i))
    else:
        lines.append(f"  rank {i}: miss -> contributes 0")
num = sum(h / i for h, i in terms)
lines.append(f"  AP@5 = ({' + '.join(f'{h}/{i}' for h, i in terms)}) / min(5, |truth|=5) = {num:.6f} / 5 = {num / 5:.6f}")
lines.append(f"  ap_at_k(...) = {ap_at_k(rec, t):.6f} -> {'MATCH' if abs(ap_at_k(rec, t) - num / 5) < 1e-12 else 'MISMATCH'}")
(OUT / "verify_map_hand.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
print("\n".join(lines))

# ====================================================================== D example users
nsub = act[act.index.isin(SUB)]
elig = nsub[nsub >= 5]
p25, p90 = float(np.percentile(elig, 25)), float(np.percentile(elig, 90))


def closest(target):
    d = pd.DataFrame({"u": elig.index, "d": (elig.values - target).__abs__()})
    return int(d.sort_values(["d", "u"]).u.iloc[0])


ex = {"light": closest(p25), "heavy": closest(p90)}
(OUT / "example_users.json").write_text(json.dumps(
    {k: {"user_id": str(v), "distinct_qualifying_training_shows": int(elig[v])} for k, v in ex.items()} |
    {"rule": f"eligible = SUB val users with >= 5 truth shows and >= 5 distinct qualifying training shows "
             f"(n={len(elig)}); light = closest to p25 = {p25}; heavy = closest to p90 = {p90}; ties smallest id"},
    indent=2))

    uh = tr[tr.user_id == np.uint64(u)].groupby("tv_show_id").watched_seconds.sum() / 3600
    top10 = pd.DataFrame({"q": uq, "h": uh.reindex(uq.index)}).reset_index().sort_values(
        ["q", "h", "tv_show_id"], ascending=[False, False, True]).head(10)
    for i, r in enumerate(top10.itertuples(), 1):
        prow.append({"role": role, "user_id": str(u), "section": "train_top10", "rank": i, "tv_show_id": r.tv_show_id,
                     "title": meta.title.get(r.tv_show_id), "category": meta.category.get(r.tv_show_id),
                     "qualifying_count": int(r.q), "watched_hours": round(float(r.h), 3)})
    tg = TRUTHS["main: weeks 21-30"]
    tu = tg[(tg.user_id == np.uint64(u)) & (tg["rank"] <= K)]

"""Step 3: validation of baselines, ceiling/robustness/breakdown, example users, test submissions.

Run: python -m src.run_step3     (no learned model is built here)
"""
import hashlib
import json
import time

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import psutil

from src import io_utils as io
from src.baselines import PF_VARIANTS, POP_VARIANTS, pf_recommend, pf_scores, pop_recommend, popularity
from src.evaluate import ap_at_k, bootstrap_ci, map_at_k, paired_bootstrap_diff
from src.labels import build_targets, n_distinct_shows
from src.make_submission import write_submission
from src.protocol import K, THR, W, get_split, labelled_airings

np.random.seed(42)
T0 = time.perf_counter()
OUT, FIG = io.ROOT / "outputs", io.ROOT / "outputs" / "figures"
DPI = 150
BLUE, ORANGE, GREY, RED, GREEN = "#3b6ea5", "#e08a2c", "#9a9a9a", "#c0392b", "#4a9a5b"
summary = {}


def savefig(fig, name):
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(FIG / name, dpi=DPI)
    plt.close(fig)


def mean_ci(ap):
    lo, hi = bootstrap_ci(ap)
    return float(ap.mean()), lo, hi


# ====================================================================== validation split
sp = get_split("val")
print("VAL split:", sp.info)
summary["val_split"] = sp.info
SUB = set(int(u) for u in sp.users[sp.sub_mask])
truth = sp.truth


def split_pop(ap):
    return {"ALL": ap, "SUB": ap[ap.index.isin(SUB)]}


def evaluate(name, family, recs, padded, t0):
    _, ap = map_at_k(recs, truth)
    row = {"method": name, "family": family}
    for pop, a in split_pop(ap).items():
        m, lo, hi = mean_ci(a)
        row.update({f"map5_{pop}": m, f"ci_lo_{pop}": lo, f"ci_hi_{pop}": hi, f"n_{pop}": len(a),
                    f"mean_padded_{pop}": float(np.mean([padded[u] for u in a.index]))})
    row["runtime_s"] = round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 2)
    return row, ap


rows, APS, RECS, POPRANK = [], {}, {}, {}
for v in POP_VARIANTS:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    POPRANK[v] = popularity(sp.train, sp.pool, v, sp.train_end)
    RECS[v], padded = pop_recommend(sp.users, POPRANK[v])
    r, APS[v] = evaluate(v, "popularity baseline", RECS[v], padded, t0)
    rows.append(r)
    print(r)
res = pd.DataFrame(rows)
res["avg_all_sub"] = (res.map5_ALL + res.map5_SUB) / 2
POP = res.sort_values(["avg_all_sub", "method"], ascending=[False, True]).method.iloc[0]
print("chosen popularity baseline (best mean of ALL and SUB MAP@5):", POP)

for v in PF_VARIANTS:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    RECS[v], padded = pf_recommend(sp.train, sp.pool, sp.users, v, POPRANK[POP], sp.train_end)
    r, APS[v] = evaluate(v, f"personal-frequency baseline (padded with {POP})", RECS[v], padded, t0)
    rows.append(r)
    print(r)
res = pd.DataFrame(rows)
res["avg_all_sub"] = (res.map5_ALL + res.map5_SUB) / 2
PF = res[res.method.isin(PF_VARIANTS)].sort_values(["avg_all_sub", "method"], ascending=[False, True]).method.iloc[0]
res["chosen"] = res.method.isin([POP, PF])
res.to_csv(OUT / "baseline_results_val.csv", index=False)
print(res[["method", "map5_ALL", "ci_lo_ALL", "ci_hi_ALL", "map5_SUB", "ci_lo_SUB", "ci_hi_SUB",
           "mean_padded_ALL", "runtime_s"]].round(4).to_string(index=False))
print("chosen personal baseline:", PF)
summary.update({"chosen_pop": POP, "chosen_pf": PF})

pd_rows = []
for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
    d, lo, hi = paired_bootstrap_diff(split_pop(APS[PF])[pop], split_pop(APS[POP])[pop])
    pd_rows.append({"population": pop, "comparison": f"{PF} - {POP}", "mean_diff": d, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
    hl = [v for v in PF_VARIANTS if v != PF]
    for v in hl:
        d, lo, hi = paired_bootstrap_diff(split_pop(APS[PF])[pop], split_pop(APS[v])[pop])
        pd_rows.append({"population": pop, "comparison": f"{PF} - {v}", "mean_diff": d, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
pdiff = pd.DataFrame(pd_rows)
pdiff.to_csv(OUT / "baseline_paired_diffs_val.csv", index=False)
print(pdiff.round(5).to_string(index=False))

# ====================================================================== C4 ceiling
tr = sp.train
hist_any = tr.groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.agg(set)
hist_q = tr[tr.frac >= THR].groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.agg(set)
ids_1120 = set(labelled_airings(["11-20"]).tv_show_id.unique().tolist())
crow = []
for pop, us in [("ALL", list(truth)), ("SUB", [u for u in truth if u in SUB])]:
    in_any = in_q = absent = 0
    ap_any, ap_q = [], []
    for u in us:
        t = truth[u]
        ha = hist_any.get(np.uint64(u), set())
        hq = hist_q.get(np.uint64(u), set())
        in_any += sum(x in ha for x in t)
        in_q += sum(x in hq for x in t)
        absent += sum(x not in ids_1120 for x in t)
        dummies = [-1, -2, -3, -4, -5]
        ap_any.append(ap_at_k(([x for x in t if x in ha] + dummies)[:K], t))
        ap_q.append(ap_at_k(([x for x in t if x in hq] + dummies)[:K], t))
    n = len(us) * K
    crow.append({"population": pop, "users": len(us), "truth_pairs": n,
                 "share_truth_in_history_any_watch": in_any / n, "share_truth_in_history_qualifying": in_q / n,
                 "ceiling_map5_history_any_watch": float(np.mean(ap_any)),
                 "ceiling_map5_history_qualifying": float(np.mean(ap_q)),
                 "share_truth_shows_absent_from_11_20_schedule": absent / n,
                 f"map5_{POP}": float(split_pop(APS[POP])[pop].mean()), f"map5_{PF}": float(split_pop(APS[PF])[pop].mean())})
ceil = pd.DataFrame(crow)
ceil.to_csv(OUT / "ceiling_analysis_val.csv", index=False)
print(ceil.T.to_string())

# ====================================================================== C5 robustness
inter = __import__("src.protocol", fromlist=["load_interactions"]).load_interactions()
clean = inter[inter.iso_week.isin([21, 22, 23, 24, 28, 29, 30])]
TRUTHS = {"main: weeks 21-30": build_targets(inter, W[21], W[31], THR),
          "clean: 21-24 + 28-30 (no 25-27)": build_targets(clean, W[21], W[31], THR),
          "weeks 21-25": build_targets(inter, W[21], W[26], THR),
          "weeks 26-30": build_targets(inter, W[26], W[31], THR)}
sub_all = set(int(u) for u in get_split("test").users)
rrows = []
for name, tg in TRUTHS.items():
    nds = n_distinct_shows(tg)
    us = nds[nds >= K].index.values.astype(np.uint64)
    top = tg[(tg["rank"] <= K) & tg.user_id.isin(us)]
    tdict = {int(u): g.tv_show_id.tolist() for u, g in top.groupby("user_id")}
    assert set(x for v in tdict.values() for x in v) <= set(sp.pool.tolist())
    pf_r, _ = pf_recommend(sp.train, sp.pool, us, PF, POPRANK[POP], sp.train_end)
    pop_r, _ = pop_recommend(us, POPRANK[POP])
    for meth, recs in [(POP, pop_r), (PF, pf_r)]:
        _, ap = map_at_k(recs, tdict)
        for pop, a in [("ALL", ap), ("SUB", ap[ap.index.isin(sub_all)])]:
            m, lo, hi = mean_ci(a)
            rrows.append({"truth_window": name, "method": meth, "population": pop, "users": len(a),
                          "map5": m, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
rob = pd.DataFrame(rrows)
rob.to_csv(OUT / "robustness_target_windows_val.csv", index=False)
print(rob.round(4).to_string(index=False))

# ====================================================================== C6 breakdown
nds_train = tr[tr.frac >= THR].groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.nunique()
act = pd.Series({u: int(nds_train.get(np.uint64(u), 0)) for u in truth})
bins, labels = [-1, 4, 9, 19, 49, np.inf], ["0-4", "5-9", "10-19", "20-49", "50+"]
bucket = pd.cut(act, bins=bins, labels=labels)
brows = []
for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
    for b in labels:
        for meth in [POP, PF]:
            a = split_pop(APS[meth])[pop]
            a = a[bucket.reindex(a.index) == b]
            m, lo, hi = mean_ci(a) if len(a) else (np.nan, np.nan, np.nan)
            brows.append({"population": pop, "activity_bucket": b, "method": meth, "users": len(a),
                          "map5": m, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
bk = pd.DataFrame(brows)
bk.to_csv(OUT / "breakdown_activity_bucket_val.csv", index=False)
print(bk.round(4).to_string(index=False))

hrows = []
for meth in [POP, PF]:
    for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
        us = split_pop(APS[meth])[pop].index
        hits = np.array([[RECS[meth][u][i] in set(truth[u]) for i in range(K)] for u in us])
        for i in range(K):
            hrows.append({"method": meth, "population": pop, "rank": i + 1,
                          "hit_rate_at_rank": hits[:, i].mean(), "share_of_all_hits": hits[:, i].sum() / hits.sum(),
                          "mean_hits_per_user": hits.sum(1).mean()})
hr = pd.DataFrame(hrows)
hr.to_csv(OUT / "hit_rank_distribution_val.csv", index=False)
print(hr.round(4).to_string(index=False))

drows = []
for meth in [POP, PF]:
    for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
        a = split_pop(APS[meth])[pop]
        d = a.describe(percentiles=[.25, .5, .75, .9]).to_dict()
        d.update({"method": meth, "population": pop, "share_ap_0": float((a == 0).mean()),
                  "share_ap_1": float((a == 1).mean())})
        drows.append(d)
pd.DataFrame(drows).to_csv(OUT / "per_user_ap_distribution_val.csv", index=False)

# ====================================================================== B4 hand-computed MAP check
meta = sp.meta
lines = [f"Hand-computed AP@5 check, personal baseline {PF} (validation split)"]
cand = None
for u in sorted(SUB):
    rec, t = RECS[PF][u], set(truth[u])
    hit = [r in t for r in rec]
    if 2 <= sum(hit) <= 4 and not hit[0] or (2 <= sum(hit) <= 4 and False in hit[:max(i for i, h in enumerate(hit) if h)]):
        cand = u
        break
u = cand
rec, t = RECS[PF][u], truth[u]
lines += [f"user_id = {u} (SUB user)",
          "recommended (rank: id title [category] -> hit?):"]
for i, r in enumerate(rec, 1):
    lines.append(f"  {i}: {r} {meta.title.get(r)} [{meta.category.get(r)}] -> {'HIT' if r in t else 'miss'}")
lines.append("truth (5 ids, order irrelevant): " + ", ".join(f"{x} {meta.title.get(x)}" for x in t))
hits, terms = 0, []
for i, r in enumerate(rec, 1):
    if r in t:
        hits += 1
        lines.append(f"  rank {i}: hit #{hits} -> P@{i} = {hits}/{i} = {hits / i:.6f}")
        terms.append((hits, i))
    else:
        lines.append(f"  rank {i}: miss -> contributes 0")
num = sum(h / i for h, i in terms)
lines.append(f"  AP@5 = ({' + '.join(f'{h}/{i}' for h, i in terms)}) / min(5, |truth|=5) = {num:.6f} / 5 = {num / 5:.6f}")
lines.append(f"  ap_at_k(...) = {ap_at_k(rec, t):.6f} -> {'MATCH' if abs(ap_at_k(rec, t) - num / 5) < 1e-12 else 'MISMATCH'}")
(OUT / "verify_map_hand.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
print("\n".join(lines))

# ====================================================================== D example users
nsub = act[act.index.isin(SUB)]
elig = nsub[nsub >= 5]
p25, p90 = float(np.percentile(elig, 25)), float(np.percentile(elig, 90))


def closest(target):
    d = pd.DataFrame({"u": elig.index, "d": (elig.values - target).__abs__()})
    return int(d.sort_values(["d", "u"]).u.iloc[0])


ex = {"light": closest(p25), "heavy": closest(p90)}
(OUT / "example_users.json").write_text(json.dumps(
    {k: {"user_id": str(v), "distinct_qualifying_training_shows": int(elig[v])} for k, v in ex.items()} |
    {"rule": f"eligible = SUB val users with >= 5 truth shows and >= 5 distinct qualifying training shows "
             f"(n={len(elig)}); light = closest to p25 = {p25}; heavy = closest to p90 = {p90}; ties smallest id"},
    indent=2))
prow = []
q = tr[tr.frac >= THR]
for role, u in ex.items():
    uq = q[q.user_id == np.uint64(u)].groupby("tv_show_id").size()
    uh = tr[tr.user_id == np.uint64(u)].groupby("tv_show_id").watched_seconds.sum() / 3600
    top10 = pd.DataFrame({"q": uq, "h": uh.reindex(uq.index)}).reset_index().sort_values(
        ["q", "h", "tv_show_id"], ascending=[False, False, True]).head(10)
    for i, r in enumerate(top10.itertuples(), 1):
        prow.append({"role": role, "user_id": str(u), "section": "train_top10", "rank": i, "tv_show_id": r.tv_show_id,
                     "title": meta.title.get(r.tv_show_id), "category": meta.category.get(r.tv_show_id),
                     "qualifying_count": int(r.q), "watched_hours": round(float(r.h), 3)})
    tg = TRUTHS["main: weeks 21-30"]
    tu = tg[(tg.user_id == np.uint64(u)) & (tg["rank"] <= K)]
    for r in tu.itertuples():

"""Step 3: validation of baselines, ceiling/robustness/breakdown, example users, test submissions.

Run: python -m src.run_step3     (no learned model is built here)
"""
import hashlib
import json
import time

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import psutil

from src import io_utils as io
from src.baselines import PF_VARIANTS, POP_VARIANTS, pf_recommend, pf_scores, pop_recommend, popularity
from src.evaluate import ap_at_k, bootstrap_ci, map_at_k, paired_bootstrap_diff
from src.labels import build_targets, n_distinct_shows
from src.make_submission import write_submission
from src.protocol import K, THR, W, get_split, labelled_airings

np.random.seed(42)
T0 = time.perf_counter()
OUT, FIG = io.ROOT / "outputs", io.ROOT / "outputs" / "figures"
DPI = 150
BLUE, ORANGE, GREY, RED, GREEN = "#3b6ea5", "#e08a2c", "#9a9a9a", "#c0392b", "#4a9a5b"
summary = {}


def savefig(fig, name):
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(FIG / name, dpi=DPI)
    plt.close(fig)


def mean_ci(ap):
    lo, hi = bootstrap_ci(ap)
    return float(ap.mean()), lo, hi


# ====================================================================== validation split
sp = get_split("val")
print("VAL split:", sp.info)
summary["val_split"] = sp.info
SUB = set(int(u) for u in sp.users[sp.sub_mask])
truth = sp.truth


def split_pop(ap):
    return {"ALL": ap, "SUB": ap[ap.index.isin(SUB)]}


def evaluate(name, family, recs, padded, t0):
    _, ap = map_at_k(recs, truth)
    row = {"method": name, "family": family}
    for pop, a in split_pop(ap).items():
        m, lo, hi = mean_ci(a)
        row.update({f"map5_{pop}": m, f"ci_lo_{pop}": lo, f"ci_hi_{pop}": hi, f"n_{pop}": len(a),
                    f"mean_padded_{pop}": float(np.mean([padded[u] for u in a.index]))})
    row["runtime_s"] = round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 2)
    return row, ap


rows, APS, RECS, POPRANK = [], {}, {}, {}
for v in POP_VARIANTS:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    POPRANK[v] = popularity(sp.train, sp.pool, v, sp.train_end)
    RECS[v], padded = pop_recommend(sp.users, POPRANK[v])
    r, APS[v] = evaluate(v, "popularity baseline", RECS[v], padded, t0)
    rows.append(r)
    print(r)
res = pd.DataFrame(rows)
res["avg_all_sub"] = (res.map5_ALL + res.map5_SUB) / 2
POP = res.sort_values(["avg_all_sub", "method"], ascending=[False, True]).method.iloc[0]
print("chosen popularity baseline (best mean of ALL and SUB MAP@5):", POP)

for v in PF_VARIANTS:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    RECS[v], padded = pf_recommend(sp.train, sp.pool, sp.users, v, POPRANK[POP], sp.train_end)
    r, APS[v] = evaluate(v, f"personal-frequency baseline (padded with {POP})", RECS[v], padded, t0)
    rows.append(r)
    print(r)
res = pd.DataFrame(rows)
res["avg_all_sub"] = (res.map5_ALL + res.map5_SUB) / 2
PF = res[res.method.isin(PF_VARIANTS)].sort_values(["avg_all_sub", "method"], ascending=[False, True]).method.iloc[0]
res["chosen"] = res.method.isin([POP, PF])
res.to_csv(OUT / "baseline_results_val.csv", index=False)
print(res[["method", "map5_ALL", "ci_lo_ALL", "ci_hi_ALL", "map5_SUB", "ci_lo_SUB", "ci_hi_SUB",
           "mean_padded_ALL", "runtime_s"]].round(4).to_string(index=False))
print("chosen personal baseline:", PF)
summary.update({"chosen_pop": POP, "chosen_pf": PF})

pd_rows = []
for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
    d, lo, hi = paired_bootstrap_diff(split_pop(APS[PF])[pop], split_pop(APS[POP])[pop])
    pd_rows.append({"population": pop, "comparison": f"{PF} - {POP}", "mean_diff": d, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
    hl = [v for v in PF_VARIANTS if v != PF]
    for v in hl:
        d, lo, hi = paired_bootstrap_diff(split_pop(APS[PF])[pop], split_pop(APS[v])[pop])
        pd_rows.append({"population": pop, "comparison": f"{PF} - {v}", "mean_diff": d, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
pdiff = pd.DataFrame(pd_rows)
pdiff.to_csv(OUT / "baseline_paired_diffs_val.csv", index=False)
print(pdiff.round(5).to_string(index=False))

# ====================================================================== C4 ceiling
tr = sp.train
hist_any = tr.groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.agg(set)
hist_q = tr[tr.frac >= THR].groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.agg(set)
ids_1120 = set(labelled_airings(["11-20"]).tv_show_id.unique().tolist())
crow = []
for pop, us in [("ALL", list(truth)), ("SUB", [u for u in truth if u in SUB])]:
    in_any = in_q = absent = 0
    ap_any, ap_q = [], []
    for u in us:
        t = truth[u]
        ha = hist_any.get(np.uint64(u), set())
        hq = hist_q.get(np.uint64(u), set())
        in_any += sum(x in ha for x in t)
        in_q += sum(x in hq for x in t)
        absent += sum(x not in ids_1120 for x in t)
        dummies = [-1, -2, -3, -4, -5]
        ap_any.append(ap_at_k(([x for x in t if x in ha] + dummies)[:K], t))
        ap_q.append(ap_at_k(([x for x in t if x in hq] + dummies)[:K], t))
    n = len(us) * K
    crow.append({"population": pop, "users": len(us), "truth_pairs": n,
                 "share_truth_in_history_any_watch": in_any / n, "share_truth_in_history_qualifying": in_q / n,
                 "ceiling_map5_history_any_watch": float(np.mean(ap_any)),
                 "ceiling_map5_history_qualifying": float(np.mean(ap_q)),
                 "share_truth_shows_absent_from_11_20_schedule": absent / n,
                 f"map5_{POP}": float(split_pop(APS[POP])[pop].mean()), f"map5_{PF}": float(split_pop(APS[PF])[pop].mean())})
ceil = pd.DataFrame(crow)
ceil.to_csv(OUT / "ceiling_analysis_val.csv", index=False)
print(ceil.T.to_string())

# ====================================================================== C5 robustness
inter = __import__("src.protocol", fromlist=["load_interactions"]).load_interactions()
clean = inter[inter.iso_week.isin([21, 22, 23, 24, 28, 29, 30])]
TRUTHS = {"main: weeks 21-30": build_targets(inter, W[21], W[31], THR),
          "clean: 21-24 + 28-30 (no 25-27)": build_targets(clean, W[21], W[31], THR),
          "weeks 21-25": build_targets(inter, W[21], W[26], THR),
          "weeks 26-30": build_targets(inter, W[26], W[31], THR)}
sub_all = set(int(u) for u in get_split("test").users)
rrows = []
for name, tg in TRUTHS.items():
    nds = n_distinct_shows(tg)
    us = nds[nds >= K].index.values.astype(np.uint64)
    top = tg[(tg["rank"] <= K) & tg.user_id.isin(us)]
    tdict = {int(u): g.tv_show_id.tolist() for u, g in top.groupby("user_id")}
    assert set(x for v in tdict.values() for x in v) <= set(sp.pool.tolist())
    pf_r, _ = pf_recommend(sp.train, sp.pool, us, PF, POPRANK[POP], sp.train_end)
    pop_r, _ = pop_recommend(us, POPRANK[POP])
    for meth, recs in [(POP, pop_r), (PF, pf_r)]:
        _, ap = map_at_k(recs, tdict)
        for pop, a in [("ALL", ap), ("SUB", ap[ap.index.isin(sub_all)])]:
            m, lo, hi = mean_ci(a)
            rrows.append({"truth_window": name, "method": meth, "population": pop, "users": len(a),
                          "map5": m, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
rob = pd.DataFrame(rrows)
rob.to_csv(OUT / "robustness_target_windows_val.csv", index=False)
print(rob.round(4).to_string(index=False))

# ====================================================================== C6 breakdown
nds_train = tr[tr.frac >= THR].groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.nunique()
act = pd.Series({u: int(nds_train.get(np.uint64(u), 0)) for u in truth})
bins, labels = [-1, 4, 9, 19, 49, np.inf], ["0-4", "5-9", "10-19", "20-49", "50+"]
bucket = pd.cut(act, bins=bins, labels=labels)
brows = []
for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
    for b in labels:
        for meth in [POP, PF]:
            a = split_pop(APS[meth])[pop]
            a = a[bucket.reindex(a.index) == b]
            m, lo, hi = mean_ci(a) if len(a) else (np.nan, np.nan, np.nan)
            brows.append({"population": pop, "activity_bucket": b, "method": meth, "users": len(a),
                          "map5": m, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi})
bk = pd.DataFrame(brows)
bk.to_csv(OUT / "breakdown_activity_bucket_val.csv", index=False)
print(bk.round(4).to_string(index=False))

hrows = []
for meth in [POP, PF]:
    for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
        us = split_pop(APS[meth])[pop].index
        hits = np.array([[RECS[meth][u][i] in set(truth[u]) for i in range(K)] for u in us])
        for i in range(K):
            hrows.append({"method": meth, "population": pop, "rank": i + 1,
                          "hit_rate_at_rank": hits[:, i].mean(), "share_of_all_hits": hits[:, i].sum() / hits.sum(),
                          "mean_hits_per_user": hits.sum(1).mean()})
hr = pd.DataFrame(hrows)
hr.to_csv(OUT / "hit_rank_distribution_val.csv", index=False)
print(hr.round(4).to_string(index=False))

drows = []
for meth in [POP, PF]:
    for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
        a = split_pop(APS[meth])[pop]
        d = a.describe(percentiles=[.25, .5, .75, .9]).to_dict()
        d.update({"method": meth, "population": pop, "share_ap_0": float((a == 0).mean()),
                  "share_ap_1": float((a == 1).mean())})
        drows.append(d)
pd.DataFrame(drows).to_csv(OUT / "per_user_ap_distribution_val.csv", index=False)

# ====================================================================== B4 hand-computed MAP check
meta = sp.meta
lines = [f"Hand-computed AP@5 check, personal baseline {PF} (validation split)"]
cand = None
for u in sorted(SUB):
    rec, t = RECS[PF][u], set(truth[u])
    hit = [r in t for r in rec]
    if 2 <= sum(hit) <= 4 and not hit[0] or (2 <= sum(hit) <= 4 and False in hit[:max(i for i, h in enumerate(hit) if h)]):
        cand = u
        break
u = cand
rec, t = RECS[PF][u], truth[u]
lines += [f"user_id = {u} (SUB user)",
          "recommended (rank: id title [category] -> hit?):"]
for i, r in enumerate(rec, 1):
    lines.append(f"  {i}: {r} {meta.title.get(r)} [{meta.category.get(r)}] -> {'HIT' if r in t else 'miss'}")
lines.append("truth (5 ids, order irrelevant): " + ", ".join(f"{x} {meta.title.get(x)}" for x in t))
hits, terms = 0, []
for i, r in enumerate(rec, 1):
    if r in t:
        hits += 1
        lines.append(f"  rank {i}: hit #{hits} -> P@{i} = {hits}/{i} = {hits / i:.6f}")
        terms.append((hits, i))
    else:
        lines.append(f"  rank {i}: miss -> contributes 0")
num = sum(h / i for h, i in terms)
lines.append(f"  AP@5 = ({' + '.join(f'{h}/{i}' for h, i in terms)}) / min(5, |truth|=5) = {num:.6f} / 5 = {num / 5:.6f}")
lines.append(f"  ap_at_k(...) = {ap_at_k(rec, t):.6f} -> {'MATCH' if abs(ap_at_k(rec, t) - num / 5) < 1e-12 else 'MISMATCH'}")
(OUT / "verify_map_hand.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
print("\n".join(lines))

# ====================================================================== D example users
nsub = act[act.index.isin(SUB)]
elig = nsub[nsub >= 5]
p25, p90 = float(np.percentile(elig, 25)), float(np.percentile(elig, 90))


def closest(target):
    d = pd.DataFrame({"u": elig.index, "d": (elig.values - target).__abs__()})
    return int(d.sort_values(["d", "u"]).u.iloc[0])


ex = {"light": closest(p25), "heavy": closest(p90)}
(OUT / "example_users.json").write_text(json.dumps(
    {k: {"user_id": str(v), "distinct_qualifying_training_shows": int(elig[v])} for k, v in ex.items()} |
    {"rule": f"eligible = SUB val users with >= 5 truth shows and >= 5 distinct qualifying training shows "
             f"(n={len(elig)}); light = closest to p25 = {p25}; heavy = closest to p90 = {p90}; ties smallest id"},
    indent=2))
prow = []
q = tr[tr.frac >= THR]
for role, u in ex.items():
    uq = q[q.user_id == np.uint64(u)].groupby("tv_show_id").size()
    uh = tr[tr.user_id == np.uint64(u)].groupby("tv_show_id").watched_seconds.sum() / 3600
    top10 = pd.DataFrame({"q": uq, "h": uh.reindex(uq.index)}).reset_index().sort_values(
        ["q", "h", "tv_show_id"], ascending=[False, False, True]).head(10)
    for i, r in enumerate(top10.itertuples(), 1):
        prow.append({"role": role, "user_id": str(u), "section": "train_top10", "rank": i, "tv_show_id": r.tv_show_id,

# Evaluation protocol (shared by all methods)

Code: `src/join.py` (matching), `src/labels.py` (targets), `src/protocol.py` (splits, pool, fallback), `src/evaluate.py` (metric). Every number below was produced by these scripts (see `outputs/LOG.md`, `join_stats.json`, `step3_summary.json`).

## 1. Matching views to programmes
- A view is the interval [start_time, start_time + duration) of one user on one channel (`vsetv_id` = schedule `channel_id`). The view end is computed from `duration`, not from `stop_time`, because 117 views crossing the 2020-03-29 DST change have stop_time − start_time = duration + 3600 s. All timestamps are naive local wall-clock time in both sources.
- 17 exact duplicate view rows are removed. Overlapping or touching views of the same user on the same channel are merged into one block (5,821,970 → 5,441,780 rows), which removes 116,216,293 s (1.35%) of double-counted time. Views on different channels are never merged.
- Airings: schedules 11-20 and 21-30 concatenated; 1 airing with duration 0 removed. Airing interval = [start, start + duration).
- Watched seconds of a (user, airing) pair = sum over the user's merged blocks on that channel of max(0, min(view_end, airing_end) − max(view_start, airing_start)). Screen time `frac` = watched seconds / airing duration (max 1.0 after merging; without merging 24,005 pairs would exceed 1).

## 3. Target recipe and tie-break
For a window [start, end): count each user's qualifying airings per tv_show_id; the target is the user's 5 most frequent tv_show_ids. Ties are broken by total watched seconds over the qualifying airings (desc), then tv_show_id (asc). **This tie-break is our convention: the competition's tie handling is unobservable.**

|---|---|---|---|---|

- **Repeats allowed:** recommending a show the user already watched is permitted for every method (repeat viewing is the main signal: 65.3% of validation truth pairs were watched in training).

## 6. Metric
MAP@5, assumed to follow the standard Kaggle definition (the competition page only names "MAP@5"): AP@5 = Σ_{i≤5} P(i)·rel(i) / min(5, |truth|), where a repeated id counts once and the order of the truth is irrelevant. Uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap over users (1,000 resamples, seed 42); comparisons use a paired bootstrap on the same resamples.

Seed 42 everywhere (bootstrap, user sampling). Two full rebuilds of the interactions table gave identical SHA-256 hashes; two full runs of Step 3 gave byte-identical result CSVs and submission files.

## Step 3: protocol, evaluator, baselines, first submissions (2026-10-30)

### What was run
1. `python -m src.test_evaluate`: 9 AP@5 cases + 1 map_at_k case, all PASS (`test_evaluate_output.txt`).
2. `python -m src.protocol`: split sizes.
3. `python -m src.run_step3` (twice, for reproducibility): stdout in `run_step3_stdout.txt` / `run_step3_stdout_run1.txt`; summary in `step3_summary.json`.
No learned model was built; the 31-42 schedule was used only for the test pool and metadata.

### Decisions
- **Splits** (`src/protocol.py`, `outputs/PROTOCOL.md`): val train = weeks 11-20 (1,824,077 pairs), truth = top-5 of weeks 21-30 (thr 0.8, our tie-break), evaluated users = ≥ 5 truth shows: ALL 4,030, SUB 1,150. Test train = weeks 11-30 (3,014,110 pairs), 1,260 template users.
- **Pool definition (deviation from the literal wording, documented):** shows with a labelled airing starting inside the target window, from all available schedule files: val 6,376, test 6,642. The literal wording ("schedule 21-30 from 05-18", "schedule 31-42") gives 6,363 / 6,636. The reason is that the files hand over per channel mid-morning, so the 11-20 file contains 283 labelled airings on 05-18 (week 21) and the 21-30 file 267 on 07-27 (week 31). All truth ids are in the pool (asserted).
- **Selection rules:** popularity baseline = best pop_* by mean(MAP ALL, MAP SUB) → **pop_recent**; personal baseline = best PF_* by the same rule (padded with pop_recent) → **PF_softfrac** (sum of frac over all training airings of the show). This is model selection on the validation set, so the chosen scores are optimistically biased. Half-lives and the 4-week recency window were tuned on a 10-week training window and may not transfer to the 20-week test training window.
- Repeats allowed; fallback = `pad_with_popularity` with the chosen popularity list restricted to the pool.
- MAP@5 = standard Kaggle definition (assumption; the competition names only "MAP@5"). CIs: 1,000 user bootstrap resamples, seed 42, 95% percentile.

### Key numbers (validation, MAP@5 [95% CI]; `baseline_results_val.csv`)
| method | ALL (n=4,030) | SUB (n=1,150) | mean padded ALL |
|---|---|---|---|
| pop_users | 0.2138 [0.2075, 0.2197] | 0.2357 [0.2248, 0.2488] | 0 |
| pop_pairs | 0.2365 [0.2303, 0.2428] | 0.2637 [0.2521, 0.2776] | 0 |
| pop_hours | 0.2281 [0.2214, 0.2347] | 0.2528 [0.2412, 0.2670] | 0 |
| **pop_recent** | 0.2398 [0.2328, 0.2466] | 0.2656 [0.2528, 0.2799] | 0 |
| PF_count_0.8 | 0.3101 [0.3029, 0.3175] | 0.3496 [0.3358, 0.3639] | 0.176 |
| PF_count_0.5 | 0.3160 [0.3090, 0.3235] | 0.3539 [0.3398, 0.3675] | 0.091 |
| **PF_softfrac** | 0.3237 [0.3168, 0.3311] | 0.3600 [0.3457, 0.3738] | 0.044 |
| PF_seconds | 0.2293 [0.2231, 0.2364] | 0.2609 [0.2484, 0.2737] | 0.044 |
| PF_decay_hl2 | 0.2867 [0.2799, 0.2939] | 0.3222 [0.3075, 0.3360] | 0.176 |
| PF_decay_hl4 | 0.3044 [0.2976, 0.3122] | 0.3440 [0.3305, 0.3586] | 0.176 |
| PF_decay_hl8 | 0.3086 [0.3014, 0.3163] | 0.3502 [0.3361, 0.3649] | 0.176 |

- Paired difference PF_softfrac − pop_recent: ALL +0.0839 [0.0770, 0.0900], SUB +0.0944 [0.0821, 0.1068]. PF_softfrac − PF_count_0.8: ALL +0.0136 [0.0112, 0.0162], SUB +0.0104 [0.0051, 0.0152] (`baseline_paired_diffs_val.csv`).
- Runtime per variant 0.4-0.8 s (popularity), 3.5-4.6 s (PF) (`baseline_runtimes_val.csv`).
- **Ceiling** (`ceiling_analysis_val.csv`): truth pairs in the user's training history with any watch: ALL 65.32% / SUB 71.03%; with a qualifying airing: 50.82% / 56.64%. A perfect history-only ranker would therefore reach MAP@5 0.6532 / 0.7103 (any watch) and 0.5082 / 0.5664 (qualifying); with all hits ranked first, AP = hits/5, so ceiling = share. Truth shows absent from the 11-20 schedule: 7.43% / 6.26%.
- **Robustness** (`robustness_target_windows_val.csv`), pop_recent / PF_softfrac:
  - main 21-30: ALL 0.2398 / 0.3237, SUB 0.2656 / 0.3600.
  - clean 21-24 + 28-30 (n=3,925 / 1,128): ALL 0.2307 / 0.3148, SUB 0.2545 / 0.3486.

  - The ranking PF > pop holds in every window (CIs do not overlap).
- **Activity buckets** (PF_softfrac vs pop_recent, ALL): 0-4 shows (n=218) 0.1170 vs 0.1240; 5-9 (383) 0.1980 vs 0.1480; 10-19 (1,104) 0.2793 vs 0.1986; 20-49 (1,894) 0.3744 vs 0.2731; 50+ (431) 0.4305 vs 0.3391.
- **Hit ranks** (ALL): PF_softfrac hit rate by rank 0.655 / 0.489 / 0.324 / 0.247 / 0.181 (1.90 hits per user); pop_recent 0.498 / 0.420 / 0.171 / 0.222 / 0.187 (1.50).
- **Per-user AP**: share AP = 0: PF 14.86% (ALL) / 11.04% (SUB), pop 25.93% / 22.52%; share AP = 1: PF 1.19% / 1.13%.
- **Hand MAP check** (`verify_map_hand.txt`): SUB user 57357915868236403, PF_softfrac hits at ranks 1, 2, 4 → (1/1 + 2/2 + 3/4)/5 = 0.55 = ap_at_k. MATCH.
- **Example users** (`example_users.json`, `example_users_profiles.csv`): eligible SUB users n = 1,112, p25 = 17, p90 = 55 distinct qualifying training shows. Light = 385172162373391221 (17 shows; truth in history 4/5 any watch, 3/5 qualifying; AP pop 0.600, PF 0.353). Heavy = 5672174985970291620 (55 shows; 4/5, 4/5; AP pop 0.483, PF 0.550).
- **Test submissions** (`outputs/submissions/`): sub01_popularity.csv (pop_recent on weeks 27-30: 2400480 240081 2400508 2400467 20088 for everyone) and sub02_personal_baseline.csv (PF_softfrac on weeks 11-30). Both pass the validator (1,260 rows, template order, 5 distinct ints, no zeros, all in the test pool, exact header). PF padding: 3 users received padded ids, 2 of them fully padded; 4 users have no qualifying training show (a user can have soft history without a qualifying airing). Not uploaded.
- **Reproducibility**: two full runs, all 12 result files and both submissions byte-identical (`step3_reproducibility.csv`). Runtime 106.1 s / 108.1 s, peak memory 1,314 / 1,235 MB.

### Bugs, failure cases and fixes
1. **Pool definition per the literal spec would have missed airings**: the 11-20 file's 05-18 morning airings belong to week 21. Fixed by defining the pool on airing time across all available files (see Decisions).
2. **Runtime in a hashed result file** would make the reproducibility check fail spuriously; moved runtimes to `baseline_runtimes_val.csv` (not hashed).
3. **Big-int ids**: test users are converted with `np.array([int(s) ...], dtype=np.uint64)` plus a round-trip assert (str → uint64 → str) to avoid the float64 bug from Step 2.
4. Plot fixes: fig 14 legend covered a bar (wider x-limit); fig 18 legend overlapped the bars (y-limit 1); fig 19 x-labels collided (shorter labels).

# sweet.tv TV programme recommender (MAP@5)

University exam project on the Kaggle sweet.tv competition. Predict, for each user, the 5 tv_show_ids
they will watch most (screen time >= 0.8) in test weeks 31-42.

## Layout

```
data/       raw CSVs (not versioned)
cache/      parquet cache built by src/io_utils.py (not versioned)
src/        code
  io_utils.py    typed loaders + parquet cache
  env_info.py    writes outputs/environment.txt
  build_cache.py builds the cache, records load time / memory
  audit.py       Step 1 data audit (CSVs + figures)
  join.py        Step 2 view/airing overlap join -> interactions
  labels.py      target builder (competition recipe)
  verify_step2.py, diagnostics_step2.py  Step 2 evidence
outputs/    CSV tables, figures/ (PNG, dpi 150), LOG.md, environment.txt
```

## Reproduce Step 1

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
python src/env_info.py
python -m src.build_cache
python -m src.audit > outputs/audit_stdout.txt
```

## Reproduce Step 2 (join, interactions, labels)

```
python -m src.join                      # -> cache/interactions.parquet, cache/watchtime_per_user.parquet, outputs/join_stats.json
python -m src.verify_step2 brute        # C1 pure-Python brute force on 30 users
python -m src.verify_step2 hand         # C2 hand-worked examples from the raw CSVs
python -m src.verify_step2 repro        # C3 two builds from an empty cache, compared
python -m src.verify_step2 merge        # C4 merge vs no-merge sensitivity
python -m src.diagnostics_step2         # A7 accounting + D1-D7 tables and figures 08-13
```

`src/labels.py` provides `build_targets(interactions, start, end, thr=0.8)` and `iso_week_start(week)`.
Note: `repro` deletes `cache/*.parquet` and rebuilds everything.

"""Method A: Personalized PageRank on a show-show co-view graph.

Graph nodes = every show in the split's TRAINING interactions (pool or not). Users x shows weight
matrix B (softfrac | count08 | log_softfrac); edges from B01 = (B > 0):
  raw              C = B01^T B01, diagonal removed (users who watched both)
  cosine           C_ij / sqrt(n_i n_j), n_i = users of show i
  weighted_cosine  cosine of the weighted columns of B
T = row-normalised C. Isolated nodes (no edge) get a self-loop T_ii = 1 so every row sums to 1.
PPR per user u: R_{t+1} = (1 - d) p_u + d R_t T, R_0 = p_u (p_u = L1-normalised seed weights),
d = continue probability; up to 50 iterations, stop when max_u ||R_{t+1} - R_t||_1 < 1e-6.
Score s_ui = R_u[i] / max(deg_i, 1) ** beta; candidates = pool shows with s > 0, ranked by s desc,
tv_show_id asc; padded with the protocol's popularity list. The graph is dense: 2,973 (val) and
4,363 (test) nodes give 71 MB / 152 MB in float64, far below 1 GB.
"""
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from itertools import islice

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.sparse as sps

from src.protocol import K, THR, pad_with_popularity


def user_show_weights(train: pd.DataFrame, kind: str) -> pd.Series:
    """Series indexed (user_id, tv_show_id) of positive weights."""
    if kind in ("softfrac", "log_softfrac"):
        w = train.frac.astype(float)
    elif kind == "count08":
        w = (train.frac >= THR).astype(float)
    else:
        raise ValueError(kind)
    s = w.groupby([train.user_id, train.tv_show_id]).sum()
    if kind == "log_softfrac":
        s = np.log1p(s)
    return s[s > 0]


@dataclass
class Graph:
    shows: np.ndarray          # node ids, sorted int64
    T: np.ndarray              # dense row-stochastic transition matrix
    deg: np.ndarray            # number of neighbours (unweighted degree)
    n_users_per_show: np.ndarray
    n_isolated: int
    n_edges: int               # undirected, diagonal excluded
    build_seconds: float
    weights: pd.Series         # (user_id, tv_show_id) -> seed weight
    users: np.ndarray          # uint64 users with >= 1 positive weight (row order of B)
    B: sps.csr_matrix          # users x shows weights


def build_graph(train: pd.DataFrame, edge: str, weight: str, dtype=np.float64) -> Graph:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    shows = np.sort(train.tv_show_id.unique()).astype(np.int64)
    w = user_show_weights(train, weight)
    u = w.index.get_level_values(0).to_numpy(np.uint64)
    s = w.index.get_level_values(1).to_numpy(np.int64)
    users, ui = np.unique(u, return_inverse=True)
    si = np.searchsorted(shows, s)
    B = sps.csr_matrix((w.to_numpy(float), (ui, si)), shape=(len(users), len(shows)))
    B01 = (B > 0).astype(np.float64)
    n_i = np.asarray(B01.sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    if edge == "raw":
        C = (B01.T @ B01).toarray()
    elif edge == "cosine":
        C = (B01.T @ B01).toarray()
        nrm = np.sqrt(n_i)
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
            C = np.nan_to_num(C / np.outer(nrm, nrm))
    elif edge == "weighted_cosine":
        C = (B.T @ B).toarray()
        nrm = np.sqrt(np.diag(C).copy())
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
            C = np.nan_to_num(C / np.outer(nrm, nrm))
    else:
        raise ValueError(edge)
    np.fill_diagonal(C, 0.0)
    deg = (C > 0).sum(axis=1)
    rs = C.sum(axis=1)
    iso = rs == 0
    C[iso, iso] = 1.0          # self-loop for isolated nodes
    rs[iso] = 1.0
    T = (C / rs[:, None]).astype(dtype)
    return Graph(shows, T, deg, n_i, int(iso.sum()), int((deg.sum()) // 2), time.perf_counter() - t0,
                 w, users, B)


def personalisation(g: Graph, users: np.ndarray, dtype=np.float64):
    """Dense P (len(users) x N) of L1-normalised seed weights; has_seed flags users with any seed."""
    row = {int(x): i for i, x in enumerate(g.users)}
    P = np.zeros((len(users), len(g.shows)), dtype=dtype)
    has = np.zeros(len(users), bool)
    for k, x in enumerate(users):
        i = row.get(int(x))
        if i is None:
            continue
        r = g.B.getrow(i)
        P[k, r.indices] = r.data / r.data.sum()
        has[k] = True
    return P, has


def ppr(P: np.ndarray, T: np.ndarray, d: float, max_iter=50, tol=1e-6, n_iter=None, batch=1000):
    """Batched power iteration. n_iter fixes the number of iterations (for linearity checks)."""
    R = np.empty_like(P)
    iters, deltas = [], []
    steps = n_iter if n_iter is not None else max_iter
    for s in range(0, len(P), batch):
        p = P[s:s + batch]
        r = p.copy()
        it, delta = 0, np.inf
        for it in range(1, steps + 1):

"""Step 4: Method A = Personalized PageRank. Run: python -m src.run_step4"""
import hashlib
import io as sysio
import json
import sys
import time

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import psutil

from src import io_utils as io
from src.baselines import pf_recommend, pop_recommend, popularity
from src.evaluate import ap_at_k, bootstrap_ci, map_at_k, paired_bootstrap_diff
from src.labels import build_targets, n_distinct_shows
from src.make_submission import write_submission
from src.ppr import build_graph, lazy_pop, personalisation, ppr, recommend
from src.protocol import K, THR, W, get_split, load_interactions, pad_with_popularity

np.random.seed(42)
T0 = time.perf_counter()
OUT, FIG = io.ROOT / "outputs", io.ROOT / "outputs" / "figures"
DPI = 150
BLUE, ORANGE, GREY, RED, GREEN = "#3b6ea5", "#e08a2c", "#9a9a9a", "#c0392b", "#4a9a5b"
EDGES, DS, WEIGHTS, BETAS = ["raw", "cosine", "weighted_cosine"], [0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.85], ["softfrac", "count08"], [0, 0.5]
summary = {}
proc = psutil.Process()


def peak_mb():
    mi = proc.memory_info()
    return round(getattr(mi, "peak_wset", mi.rss) / 1024**2)


def log(*a):
    print(*a, flush=True)


def savefig(fig, name):
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(FIG / name, dpi=DPI)
    plt.close(fig)


# ====================================================================== setup
sp = get_split("val")
SUB = set(int(u) for u in sp.users[sp.sub_mask])
truth = sp.truth
tr = sp.train
for name, s, lim in [("val", sp, W[21]), ("test", None, W[31])]:
    pass
log(f"[B4] val graph training airing_start min {tr.airing_start.min()} max {tr.airing_start.max()}")
assert tr.airing_start.max() < W[21]
summary["leakage_val"] = {"min": str(tr.airing_start.min()), "max": str(tr.airing_start.max())}

POPV = popularity(tr, sp.pool, "pop_recent", sp.train_end)
pop_recs, _ = pop_recommend(sp.users, POPV)
pf_recs, pf_pad = pf_recommend(tr, sp.pool, sp.users, "PF_softfrac", POPV, sp.train_end)
step3 = pd.read_csv(OUT / "baseline_results_val.csv").set_index("method")
hist = {int(u): set(s) for u, s in tr.groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.agg(set).items()}
nq = tr[tr.frac >= THR].groupby("user_id").tv_show_id.nunique()


def evaluate(recs, tdict=None, sub=SUB):
    tdict = truth if tdict is None else tdict
    _, ap = map_at_k(recs, tdict)
    res = {}
    for pop, a in (("ALL", ap), ("SUB", ap[ap.index.isin(sub)])):
        lo, hi = bootstrap_ci(a)
        res[pop] = {"map5": float(a.mean()), "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi, "n": len(a), "ap": a}
    return res


E_POP, E_PF = evaluate(pop_recs), evaluate(pf_recs)
for m, e in [("pop_recent", E_POP), ("PF_softfrac", E_PF)]:
    for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
        assert abs(e[pop]["map5"] - step3.loc[m, f"map5_{pop}"]) < 1e-12, (m, pop)
log("baselines reproduce Step 3 exactly:", {m: (round(e['ALL']['map5'], 4), round(e['SUB']['map5'], 4))
                                             for m, e in [("pop_recent", E_POP), ("PF_softfrac", E_PF)]})

# ====================================================================== A6 grid (float32)
log("[A6] grid: 3 edges x 4 d x 2 seed weights x 2 beta (PPR in float32; beta reuses R)")
rows, RT = [], []
for edge in EDGES:
    for weight in WEIGHTS:
        g = build_graph(tr, edge, weight, dtype=np.float32)
        P, has = personalisation(g, sp.users, dtype=np.float32)
        for d in DS:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            R, info = ppr(P, g.T, d)
            t_ppr = time.perf_counter() - t0
            for beta in BETAS:

                recs, padded, _ = recommend(R, has, sp.users, g, sp.pool, beta, POPV)
                e = evaluate(recs)
                row = {"edge": edge, "seed_weight": weight, "d": d, "beta": beta}
                for pop in ["ALL", "SUB"]:
                    row.update({f"map5_{pop}": e[pop]["map5"], f"ci_lo_{pop}": e[pop]["ci_lo"],
                                f"ci_hi_{pop}": e[pop]["ci_hi"]})
                row.update({"avg_all_sub": (e["ALL"]["map5"] + e["SUB"]["map5"]) / 2,
                            "mean_padded_ALL": float(np.mean([padded[u] for u in truth])),
                            "users_without_seed": int((~has).sum()), "ppr_iterations_max": info["max_iterations"],

                rows.append(row)

                log(f"  {edge:16s} {weight:8s} d={d:<5} beta={beta:<4} ALL {row['map5_ALL']:.4f} SUB {row['map5_SUB']:.4f} "
                    f"iters {info['max_iterations']} {RT[-1]['runtime_seconds']}s")
        del g, P
grid = pd.DataFrame(rows).merge(pd.DataFrame(RT), on=["edge", "seed_weight", "d", "beta"])
grid.to_csv(OUT / "ppr_grid_val.csv", index=False)
rank = grid.assign(er=grid.edge.map({e: i for i, e in enumerate(EDGES)}),
                   wr=grid.seed_weight.map({"count08": 0, "softfrac": 1}))
best = rank.sort_values(["avg_all_sub", "runtime_seconds", "er", "beta", "wr"],
                        ascending=[False, True, True, True, True]).iloc[0]
CFG = {"edge": best.edge, "seed_weight": best.seed_weight, "d": float(best.d), "beta": float(best.beta)}
summary["selected"] = CFG
summary["selected_grid_float32"] = {"map5_ALL": float(best.map5_ALL), "map5_SUB": float(best.map5_SUB)}
log("[A6] selected (best mean of ALL and SUB MAP@5; tie -> faster -> simpler):", CFG, summary["selected_grid_float32"])
summary["grid_seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - T0, 1)

# ====================================================================== selected config, float64
ROB = {"main: weeks 21-30": build_targets(load_interactions(), W[21], W[31], THR)}
inter = load_interactions()
ROB["clean: 21-24 + 28-30 (no 25-27)"] = build_targets(inter[inter.iso_week.isin([21, 22, 23, 24, 28, 29, 30])],
                                                       W[21], W[31], THR)
ROB["weeks 21-25"] = build_targets(inter, W[21], W[26], THR)
ROB["weeks 26-30"] = build_targets(inter, W[26], W[31], THR)
ROB_T = {}
for k, tg in ROB.items():
    nds = n_distinct_shows(tg)
    us = nds[nds >= K].index
    top = tg[(tg["rank"] <= K) & tg.user_id.isin(us)]
    ROB_T[k] = {int(u): g_.tv_show_id.tolist() for u, g_ in top.groupby("user_id")}
assert ROB_T["main: weeks 21-30"] == truth
U = np.array(sorted(set().union(*[set(t) for t in ROB_T.values()])), dtype=np.uint64)


def run_selected(train, users, pool, pop, cfg, history_=None):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    g = build_graph(train, cfg["edge"], cfg["seed_weight"])
    P, has = personalisation(g, users)
    t1 = time.perf_counter()
    R, info = ppr(P, g.T, cfg["d"])
    t_ppr = time.perf_counter() - t1
    full = recommend(R, has, users, g, pool, cfg["beta"], pop)
    new = recommend(R, has, users, g, pool, cfg["beta"], pop, mode="new_only", history=history_) if history_ else None
    return {"g": g, "P": P, "has": has, "R": R, "info": info, "full": full, "new": new,
            "graph_seconds": g.build_seconds, "ppr_seconds": t_ppr, "total_seconds": time.perf_counter() - t0}


S = run_selected(tr, U, sp.pool, POPV, CFG, hist)
G = S["g"]
uidx = {int(u): i for i, u in enumerate(U)}
ppr_recs = {u: S["full"][0][u] for u in truth}
ppr_pad = {u: S["full"][1][u] for u in truth}
E_PPR = evaluate(ppr_recs)
log("[C1] selected PPR float64:", {p: round(E_PPR[p]["map5"], 4) for p in ["ALL", "SUB"]},
    "iterations", S["info"]["iterations_per_batch"], "converged", S["info"]["converged"])
summary["ppr_val"] = {p: {k: v for k, v in E_PPR[p].items() if k != "ap"} for p in ["ALL", "SUB"]}
summary["ppr_val_iterations"] = S["info"]["iterations_per_batch"]
summary["ppr_val_mean_padded_ALL"] = float(np.mean(list(ppr_pad.values())))
summary["graph_val"] = {"nodes": len(G.shows), "undirected_edges": G.n_edges,
                        "density": G.n_edges / (len(G.shows) * (len(G.shows) - 1) / 2), "isolated_nodes": G.n_isolated,
                        "seed_users": len(G.users)}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- B3 sanity
rs = G.T.sum(axis=1)
Rs = S["R"][S["has"]].sum(axis=1)
summary["sanity"] = {"T_row_sum_min": float(rs.min()), "T_row_sum_max": float(rs.max()),
                     "isolated_nodes_selfloop": G.n_isolated,
                     "R_row_sum_min": float(Rs.min()), "R_row_sum_max": float(Rs.max())}
gs = build_graph(tr, CFG["edge"], "softfrac")

n_pool_seed = pd.Series({u: len(hist.get(u, set()) & set(sp.pool.tolist())) for u in truth})

log("[B3]", summary["sanity"])
del gs, Ps, R01

T = G.T

    nz = np.flatnonzero(T[i])
    adj.append((nz.tolist(), T[i, nz].tolist()))
col = {int(x): i for i, x in enumerate(G.shows)}
pool_set = set(sp.pool.tolist())
deg = G.deg.tolist()
nrows = []
for u in pick:
    u = int(u)
    seed = {}
    for sh, fr in zip(tr.tv_show_id[tr.user_id == np.uint64(u)].tolist(), tr.frac[tr.user_id == np.uint64(u)].tolist()):
        w = fr if CFG["seed_weight"] == "softfrac" else (1.0 if fr >= THR else 0.0)
        seed[col[sh]] = seed.get(col[sh], 0.0) + w
    seed = {i: w for i, w in seed.items() if w > 0}
    tot = sum(seed.values())
    p = [0.0] * len(adj)
    for i, w in seed.items():
        p[i] = w / tot
    r = list(p)
    d = CFG["d"]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for it in range(1, 51):
        new = [(1 - d) * x for x in p]
        for i in range(len(adj)):
            ri = r[i]
            if ri:
                idx, val = adj[i]
                for j, t in zip(idx, val):
                    new[j] += d * ri * t
        delta = sum(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(new, r))
        r = new
        if delta < 1e-6:
            break
    Rv, _ = ppr(S["P"][[uidx[u]]], T, d, n_iter=it)
    diff = float(np.max(np.abs(np.array(r) - Rv[0])))
    diff_main = float(np.max(np.abs(np.array(r) - S["R"][uidx[u]])))
    sc = [(r[i] / max(deg[i], 1) ** CFG["beta"], int(G.shows[i])) for i in range(len(adj)) if int(G.shows[i]) in pool_set]
    sc = [x for x in sc if x[0] > 0]
    sc.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]))
    naive_top = pad_with_popularity([x[1] for x in sc[:K]], POPV)
    nrows.append({"user_id": str(u), "naive_iterations": it, "max_abs_diff_same_iterations": diff,
                  "max_abs_diff_vs_main_run": diff_main, "top5_naive": " ".join(map(str, naive_top)),
                  "top5_vectorised": " ".join(map(str, ppr_recs[u])), "top5_identical": naive_top == ppr_recs[u],
                  "seconds": round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 1)})
    log("   ", nrows[-1])
